description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Long-Term Leadership Role



Salary: $2,500–$4,000 per month during the 2-month trial, based on approved experience level.

After successful completion of trial and certification requirements: $3,000–$5,000 per month (pre-agreed base) plus performance-based bonuses.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



This is not a short-term job.

We build long-term leadership inside the company.



You will work directly with the leadership team to improve performance, systems, and retention across our Customer Success department.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company.

We work with content creators and online brands.



We provide an 80 percent done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies.



Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators who want to grow their brand, get followers, and make money online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.



BENEFITS



- Full-time stable income

- Monday to Friday schedule

- Flexible working hours

- Reliable monthly payments via Wise

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear salary progression after trial

- Real ownership and leadership responsibility

- Direct collaboration with senior leadership

- Clear path to senior leadership or director level

- Access to paid AI tools and systems

- High-growth environment

- Strong company culture



TASKS



- Lead and manage CSMs, onboarding managers, and content support roles

- Monitor daily reports and team performance

- Audit onboarding calls, client calls, DMs, and check-ins

- Run weekly team training and review calls

- Identify underperformers early and take action

- Oversee CRM health in Airtable

- Improve reporting systems and dashboards

- Align Customer Success with Sales and leadership

- Improve onboarding, escalation, churn rescue, and upsell SOPs

- Fix operational gaps and build scalable systems

- Help interview and train new team members

- Proactively identify at-risk clients

- Oversee refund and dispute handling

- Solve root causes behind churn



This is a leadership role. You are trusted to own outcomes, not be micromanaged on tasks.

If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of experience in customer success operations, community management, or similar

- Experience managing or coordinating 10–20 team members

- Strong Airtable, Slack, and Google Workspace experience

- Experience building SOPs, dashboards, and reporting systems

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Self-starter mentality

- Comfortable working across multiple time zones



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Restructuring customer success teams

- High-ticket coaching or online education

- Knowledge of churn analysis and lifecycle metrics

- Working in a CS agency

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: TECHNICAL ONBOARDING SPECIALIST (TECH-FOCUSED) - $900 P/M + BONUSES (UP TO $1,400 P/M)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Outbound Sales Representative – Real Estate Media Bookings
description:
Outbound Sales Representative – Real Estate Media Bookings



Company: Priceless Productions RE Type: Full-Time (40 hrs/week) Pay: $4.00 USD/hour base + 1% commission on all booked sales Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday



About Us:

Priceless Productions is a real estate media company providing photography, video, drone, Matterport, and floor plan services to real estate agents in the Richmond, VA and Northern Virginia markets. We're building out a scalable sales and marketing engine, and this role is a core part of that growth.



The Role:

We're looking for a sharp, persistent, and coachable Outbound Sales Representative to cold call real estate agents, generate interest in our media services, and book appointments/shoots directly into our pipeline. This is not a script-reading job — you'll be trained on our services, our ideal client, and our objection handling, and you'll be measured on real booked revenue, not just call volume.



What You'll Do:

-Make outbound cold calls daily to real estate agents in our two active markets — Richmond, VA and Northern Virginia (NOVA) to introduce Priceless Productions RE's services

-Qualify leads and identify agents actively listing or about to list properties

-Book photography/video/media appointments directly into our scheduling system (
 / HD PhotoHub)

-Follow up consistently with warm leads who don't convert on the first call

-Log every call outcome accurately in our CRM, including which market the booking belongs to (no exceptions — data quality is part of the job)

-Hit weekly/monthly call volume and booking targets

-Report daily/weekly activity and results to management



What Success Looks Like (KPIs):

-Calls per day: 80–100

-Appointments/bookings per week: 3–5 to start, with targets increasing as you ramp up and build rapport with our agent network

-Show-up/completion rate on booked jobs

CRM logging accuracy: 100% of calls logged same-day, tagged by market (Richmond or NOVA)



Who We're Looking For:

We want outgoing, ambitious, competitive people who genuinely enjoy sales, not someone looking for a quiet data-entry job. If you like the challenge of turning a "no" into a "yes" and want your paycheck to reflect your effort, this is for you.



Requirements:

Proven cold calling or outbound sales experience (real estate industry experience a strong plus)

Excellent spoken English with a neutral, professional phone presence

Comfortable handling rejection and staying persistent without getting discouraged

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work environment, and a working headset

Experience with CRM tools (
 experience a plus, but trainable)

Self-motivated — able to work independently and hit targets without micromanagement

Available for full-time hours, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday



Compensation Details:

Base pay: $4.00/hour, paid weekly

Commission: 1% of the total value of every booked sale that results from your outbound calls, paid once the job is completed/invoiced

Example: Our average job is $400–$500, so every booking earns you an extra $4–$5 on top of your hourly rate — with no cap on how many you can book. Book 5 jobs in a week and that's an extra $20–25 added straight to your paycheck.

Performance review at 30/60/90 days with opportunity for base pay increase based on results

How to Apply



Please apply with:

A short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself in English

Your cold calling / sales experience, specifically any real estate or service-based industry experience

Your available start date



Applications without a voice sample will not be considered.

title: Experienced Meta & Google Ads Specialist Needed for Long-Term Work
description:
Experienced Meta & Google Ads Specialist Needed for Long-Term Work



About Us



West Michigan Piano is a family-owned piano shop in Grand Rapids, Michigan. We've served Grand Rapids for 20+ years, offering new and used pianos / rentals / tuning & repair / piano moving etc. We're looking for a paid-ads specialist to help us reach more local customers and turn online searches and scrolls into real leads — phone calls, form inquiries, and showroom visits.



This is a long-term, remote opportunity. We want someone dependable we can grow with, not a one-off campaign. However, there will be a testing period to make sure we’re aligned and the skills are there. Also, dont reach out directly to the store or try to find the owner to bypass the recruiting process, I appreciate the tenacity but I’m handling this for my uncle and he doesn’t want to deal with this until I introduce people to him. 



What You'll Do



Build, launch, and manage Google Ads — Search campaigns targeting high-intent local searches (e.g. "used pianos near me," "piano tuning [city]," "piano lessons"), plus Performance Max and Google Business Profile optimization

Build and manage Meta Ads 
 + Instagram) for lead generation, retargeting, and promoting [lessons / seasonal sales / events



Set up and maintain conversion tracking correctly — Meta Pixel/Conversions API, Google Ads conversion actions, and call & form tracking so we can actually measure leads



Research audiences and keywords specific to piano buyers, lesson seekers, and tuning/repair customers in our area



Write ad copy and direct the creative — tell us what photos/videos/assets you need and we'll provide them

Manage the ad budget efficiently and report on leads, cost-per-lead, and what's working in plain English



Continuously test and optimize to lower cost-per-lead over time



What We're Looking For (Requirements)



1. Proven paid-ads experience. 5+ years actively running both Google Ads and Meta Ads with real, measurable results. This is not an entry-level role — we're not looking for someone learning on our budget. Bonus if you’ve worked with Piano shops before.

2. Local / lead-generation experience, this is the big one for us. You've run ads for local service or retail businesses (not just e-commerce or dropshipping). You understand geo-targeting, driving phone calls and in-person visits, and getting results on a modest local budget.

3. Conversion tracking competence. You can set up pixels, conversion actions, and call/form tracking correctly and verify they're firing. (This is where most applicants fall down — we'll be asking about it.)

4. Clear communication and fluent English. You'll report directly to the owner and explain results simply, without jargon. Strong written English is required.



What To Submit



Your portfolio / track record — examples of ad accounts or campaigns you've managed, ideally for local or lead-gen businesses. Include results where you can: leads generated, cost per lead, monthly ad spend you've managed.

A short note answering: "Why would you be a valuable asset to us, and what's the first thing you'd do to get us more leads?" (We want to see that you've actually thought about our business.)



Please Note

Any AI-generated or ChatGPT applications will be automatically disregarded. We want to hear from you, in your own words.

So we know you actually read this: start your reply with the word “Michigan”.



The Details



Type: Long-term, remote after trial period

Reporting to: The shop owner directly

Start:As soon as we find the right fit"

title: Setup Specialist (Applicants must hold a Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Setup Specialist (Initial Disclosure Specialist)



Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, or a related field ONLY. Applicants without this degree requirement will not be considered.



We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Setup Specialist to join our mortgage operations team. Your main responsibility is to prepare and review initial mortgage disclosures to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery to borrowers. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants long-term stability, growth, and a work-from-home setup.



Job Responsibilities



Prepare and review initial mortgage disclosures with strict attention to accuracy and compliance.

Ensure disclosures are delivered on time and in accordance with federal and state regulations.

Coordinate with loan officers, processors, and internal teams to collect required information.

Stay updated on mortgage regulations and compliance requirements.

Identify, investigate, and resolve any discrepancies in disclosure documents.

Help improve internal policies, checklists, and workflows for the disclosure process.

Maintain well-organized and accurate documentation of disclosure activities.



Qualifications



Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, or related field (required).

Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently and collaborate in a fast-paced environment.

Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable learning new software.

Experience in US mortgage industry is a plus but not required.



Benefits



Competitive salary + performance incentives

Paid time off and holidays (after regularization)

Work-from-home setup

Long-term position with opportunities for promotion

Paid training and periodic salary reviews



Work Schedule



Full-time (40 hours/week)

Night shift / Rotational shift

Monday to Friday

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements:

Reliable computer capable of handling mortgage systems and multiple documents

title: Full-Time Remote Shopify Developer
description:
We build and launch Shopify dropshipping stores at a fast pace, roughly one new store per week. We're looking for a skilled Shopify developer to own the technical side of that process end-to-end, on a long-term full-time basis.



What you'll work on

- Building complete Shopify storefronts from Figma mockups or HTML references, pixel-accurate, fast, and clean

- Theme customization and development using Liquid

- Page speed optimization and Core Web Vitals

- Google Merchant Center compliance: structured data, clean code, zero errors

- Fixing 404s, broken links, redirect issues and technical debt across our store portfolio

- CRO improvements on product pages, checkout flows, and landing pages

- Ongoing maintenance across multiple stores



What we're looking for

- 3+ years of solid Shopify / Liquid development experience

- Strong command of HTML, CSS and JavaScript

- Ability to faithfully translate a Figma file or HTML mockup into a working storefront

- Strong technical fundamentals: clean code, SEO-ready markup, GMC-compliant structure

- Fast and autonomous: we provide detailed SOPs and assets upfront, you execute with minimal hand-holding

- A good eye for detail and some creative initiative when needed

- Good written English and stable internet connection



What we offer

- $2,000-$3,000/month depending on experience

- Full-time remote, contractor basis (monthly invoicing)

- Long-term engagement with consistent, recurring work across multiple stores

- Clear briefs, assets provided upfront, fast feedback loop



How to apply

Send us a short intro about your Shopify experience, 2-3 examples of stores or pages you've built (screenshots or live URLs), and your expected monthly rate. We move fast with the right candidates.

title: Video Editor – YouTube, Short-Form & Podcast Content
description:
We’re looking for a **Video Editor** to help us turn our weekly coaching and sales calls into high-quality content for YouTube, social media, our client Learning Center, and podcast platforms.



We’re looking for someone who can watch long-form content, understand what is being discussed, identify the strongest moments, and turn them into clean, engaging content.



*What You'll Be Editing



We have several recurring calls each week:



**Tuesday – Coaching Calls**



* Edit the full coaching call for our Learning Center and YouTube

* Incorporate presentation slides/PPTs

* Identify strong moments for short-form social media content

* Identify client wins and testimonials that can become standalone content



**Thursday – Deal Desk**



* Turn each deal/case discussed into a standalone YouTube video

* Extract strong short-form clips from the conversation



**Friday – Live Call Reviews**



* Turn reviewed calls into standalone YouTube videos

* Identify useful or interesting moments for social media



**Podcast**



* Prepare clean audio versions of long-form content for podcast distribution



*What We're Looking For



You should be able to:



* Edit long-form YouTube content

* Create engaging short-form videos for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn

* Remove filler, pauses, repetition, and unnecessary sections while preserving context

* Create clean, professional on-screen captions

* Write short social media captions to accompany the clips you create

* Work with presentation slides and other supporting visuals

* Organize multiple pieces of content from the same source recording

* Meet weekly publishing deadlines consistently



*The Most Important Skill



You need to be able to watch a conversation and recognize:



* A strong insight

* A useful lesson

* An interesting story

* A client win

* A compelling opinion

* A moment that could become a strong social media clip



We do not want someone who simply cuts random 30–60 second sections from a call.



* Ideal Candidate



You may be a good fit if you:



* Have experience editing podcasts, coaching content, business content, interviews, or educational videos

* Understand YouTube and short-form social content

* Have strong attention to detail

* Can work independently

* Are comfortable working with recurring weekly content



Experience with sales, real estate, coaching, or business content is a plus, but not required.



* Application Process



If your experience looks like a good fit, we’ll invite you to complete a short video editing assessment using footage from one of our real Deal Desk sessions.



The assessment will test both your editing ability and your ability to identify strong content from a longer conversation.



*How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction

2. Links to 2–3 examples of your best work

3. At least one example of long-form YouTube or podcast editing, if available

4. At least one example of short-form content you've edited

5. The editing software you primarily use

6. Your expected monthly salary for a full-time role



Please start your application with the words **“DEAL DESK”** so we know you read the full job post.

title: Vendor Management & Transactional Procurement
description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

Roles:

1. Vendor Management staff

2. Transactional Procurement staff



Company: Logic Minds

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Work From Home – Philippines-Based

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours

Reports To: Logic Minds Management





ABOUT LOGIC MINDS

Logic Minds is an Australian company committed to building long-term relationships with our customers, suppliers, and staff. We believe strong relationships are built through trust, accountability, responsiveness, and consistently delivering high-quality work from end to end.

Our aim is to create sustainable partnerships that provide value to our customers while maintaining high standards across our suppliers, processes, and services.



Logic Minds is built around five key pillars: 

Reducing our clients’ expense bases

1. Sourcing sustainable products and services that support long-term relationships

2. Never compromise on quality

3. Future-proofing company processes by implementing scalable controls and processes

4. Respect, Respond and React to all customer needs

________________________________________



ABOUT THE ROLES  

Logic Minds is seeking an experienced and proactive Vendor Management & Transactional Procurement staff to join our team in a work-from-home capacity.

This role will be responsible for managing and strengthening relationships with suppliers and vendors while ensuring Logic Minds consistently achieves the best combination of cost, quality, service, reliability, and value.

This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is highly organised, process-driven, and confident in communicating with both vendors and senior stakeholders.

The successful candidate will work closely with suppliers, internal stakeholders, customers, and senior executives to ensure vendor relationships are effectively managed, and that agreed standards, pricing, service levels, and quality requirements are consistently met.

The ideal candidate will also be comfortable working independently from home, managing competing priorities, identifying issues before they become problems, and taking ownership of finding practical solutions.



CORE VALUES

The successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate Logic Minds’ core approach in every aspect of their work:

• RESPECT

Treat customers, suppliers, colleagues, and stakeholders with professionalism and respect.

• RESPOND

Communicate promptly, clearly, and professionally.

• REACT

Take action, solve problems, and follow matters through to completion.

KEY PERFORMANCE OUTCOMES 

Success in this role will be measured by the individual’s ability to:

• Build and maintain strong, reliable vendor relationships.

• Achieve competitive pricing and measurable cost savings where appropriate.

• Maintain high supplier performance and quality standards.

• Resolve vendor and customer issues quickly and effectively.

• Ensure vendor documentation and records are accurate and up to date.

• Maintain strong communication with Australian clients, suppliers, and senior stakeholders.

• Identify and implement process improvements.

• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Consistently meet deadlines and agreed deliverables.

• Work independently while keeping management appropriately informed.

• Contribute to scalable and sustainable vendor management processes.

• Support Logic Minds’ commitment to Respect, Respond and React to customer needs.



________________________________________



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

1. Vendor & Supplier Relationship Management

• Develop and maintain strong, professional relationships with vendors and suppliers.

• Act as a key point of contact for vendor-related matters.

• Communicate regularly with suppliers to maintain strong working relationships and ensure expectations are clearly understood.

• Manage supplier queries, concerns, escalations, and service issues promptly and professionally.

• Build long-term supplier partnerships aligned with Logic Minds’ business objectives.

• Ensure suppliers understand and consistently meet agreed requirements and expectations.



2. Pricing, Quotes & Cost Management 

• Source and obtain competitive supplier pricing, quotes, and proposals.

• Review supplier pricing and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve value.

• Assist with price negotiations and commercial discussions with suppliers.

• Compare supplier quotes and assess overall value, not simply price.

• Monitor pricing changes and identify opportunities for savings.

• Maintain accurate records of pricing, quotes, supplier agreements, and relevant commercial information.

• Support Logic Minds’ objective of reducing clients’ expense bases through effective supplier management.



3. Vendor Performance & Quality Management 

• Monitor supplier performance against agreed expectations, service levels, quality standards, and delivery requirements.

• Identify recurring vendor performance issues and implement appropriate corrective actions.

• Follow up with suppliers to ensure issues are resolved within agreed timeframes.

• Escalate significant or ongoing supplier issues to management when required.

• Maintain accurate vendor performance records and documentation.

• Ensure quality is never compromised in the pursuit of cost savings.



4. Vendor Compliance & Process Management

• Ensure vendor documentation, agreements, pricing, and other relevant records are current and accurately maintained.

• Assist in implementing and maintaining effective vendor management processes and controls.

• Ensure vendor-related procedures are followed consistently.

• Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and risks and recommend improvements.

• Help develop scalable processes that can support the future growth of Logic Minds and its clients.

• Maintain organised and accurate vendor records and documentation.



5. Reporting & Data Management

• Maintain accurate vendor databases, spreadsheets, reports, and records.

• Prepare regular reports relating to supplier performance, pricing, costs, savings, and other relevant vendor metrics.

• Use Excel to analyse vendor data and identify trends, discrepancies, cost-saving opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Ensure vendor information is accurate, current, and easily accessible.

• Provide management with clear and concise information to support decision-making.



6. Customer & Stakeholder Communication

• Work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to understand vendor-related requirements.

• Respond promptly and professionally to customer and stakeholder requests.

• Communicate effectively with Australian clients and senior executives.

• Manage sensitive or complex vendor and customer matters with professionalism and sound judgement.

• Ensure customer needs are respected, responded to, and acted upon in accordance with the Logic Minds values.



7. Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve vendor management processes.

• Investigate issues and determine practical, sustainable solutions.

• Look beyond immediate problems to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

• Recommend improvements to supplier processes, controls, and workflows.

• Support the ongoing development of efficient, scalable, and future-proof vendor management systems.

________________________________________



ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

The successful candidate must have:



Communication

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Strong professional communication and interpersonal skills.

• Confidence communicating with suppliers, customers, internal stakeholders, and senior executives.

• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with Australian clients.



Customer Service & Australian Client Experience

• Previous experience in customer service, account management, vendor management, procurement, administration, or similar role is given a priority.

• Demonstrated experience working directly with Australian clients or businesses.

• Strong understanding of professional expectations when dealing with Australian customers and stakeholders.

• Proven ability to manage customer and supplier relationships professionally.



Excel & Data Management

• Excellent Microsoft Excel skills are essential.

• Ability to confidently manage, analyse, organise, and report on large amounts of information.

• Strong attention to detail when working with spreadsheets, pricing, supplier data, and reports.

• Ability to use Excel to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement.



Vendor Management

• Experience managing suppliers, vendors, contractors, or external service providers.

• Experience handling supplier communication, quotes, pricing, negotiations, performance, and issue resolution.

• Strong ability to balance cost, quality, service, and supplier relationships.

________________________________________



PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES



Essential

The successful candidate will be:

• Self-motivated – able to maintain productivity and accountability while working remotely.

• Proactive – identifies issues and opportunities without always needing to be directed.

• Highly organised – able to manage multiple vendors, tasks, deadlines, and priorities.

• Independent – comfortable working autonomously from a home office.

• Confident – comfortable communicating with senior executives and experienced business stakeholders.

• Professional – demonstrates maturity and sound judgement when dealing with customers and suppliers.



Important

The successful candidate should also be:

• A fast learner who can quickly understand new systems, processes, products, and requirements.

• A strong problem solver who can investigate issues and develop practical solutions.

• Process-driven with a strong focus on consistency and accountability.

• Highly detail-oriented with excellent accuracy when managing vendor information, pricing, documentation, and reports.

• Commercially minded with an understanding of cost, value, quality, and supplier performance.

• Adaptable and able to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• A strong relationship builder who understands the importance of trust and long-term partnerships.

________________________________________



Work Requirements



Location

• Philippines

• Work From Home



Hours

• Full-time

• Monday to Friday

• Melbourne, Australia business hours

• 8:30am – 5:00pm Melbourne time (equivalent to 6:30 am – 3:00 pm Philippine time, subject to seasonal daylight savings changes)



Leave

• Holidays: 20 days paid holiday per year accrued

• Sick Leave: 10 days paid sick leave per year accrued, provided with a medical certificate

• Public Holidays: Australian Public Holidays



Equipment Required

• Reliable internet connection

• Modern computer/laptop

• Quality headset

• Quiet home office environment

• Backup internet/power supply required



Salary

o Probation 3-month period: 23,000 pesos

o After probation: 25,000 pesos

o Pay Cycle: 15th to 16th of each month, with salary paid on the 15th.

o Annual Increase: 1,000 PESO anniversary date

o Bonus: Additional Month Salary each DECEMBER (pro-rata). 

Note: 13th month bonus is only applicable to staff who are still with the company on month of December.

title: Administrative Co-Ordinator

ADMINISTRATIVE CO-ORDINATOR (REMOTE)



ABOUT US



We are a well-established Caribbean company operating two businesses:



Seasons Fashion – a retail fashion business with a physical store and online operations.



Park View Apartments – a serviced apartment business catering primarily to international medical students and visitors.



We are looking for an intelligent, highly organised and proactive Administrative Co-Ordinator to provide remote administrative support across both businesses.



We are looking for someone who will become a trusted and dependable member of our team over the long term.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is NOT a traditional 40-hour-per-week position.



The position operates on a monthly retainer.



Our workload is seasonal and varies considerably throughout the year. Some weeks and months can be extremely busy, while others may require relatively little work.



We are therefore not looking for someone to sit at a computer for eight hours every day simply to fulfil a fixed number of hours.



What matters to us is availability, responsiveness, reliability and the ability to get things done accurately when required.



This arrangement may particularly suit an experienced remote professional who values the stability of a long-term client relationship while retaining some flexibility in how they manage their time.



RESPONSIBILITIES



The Administrative Co-Ordinator will provide support across a wide variety of administrative and operational activities, which may include:



* Customer and tenant communication by
, WhatsApp and live chat

* Responding to
 and Instagram 

* Preparing business correspondence and documents

* Preparing leases and other tenant documentation

* Calendar and appointment management

* Supplier and product research

* General internet research

* Spreadsheet updates and data management

* Preparing monthly electricity billing calculations for tenants

* Preparing data files for import into Xero

* Customer database maintenance

* Preparing reports

* Proofreading correspondence and documents

* Digital file organisation

* Assisting with the preparation and maintenance of SOPs

* Preparing meeting minutes from recorded meetings

* Project and task tracking

* AI-assisted administrative work

* Other general administrative and operational support as required



The nature of the position means that no two weeks will necessarily look the same.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are particularly interested in someone who:



* Has excellent written and spoken English

* Is exceptionally organised

* Has excellent attention to detail

* Thinks logically and carefully

* Learns new systems and processes quickly

* Can follow detailed instructions and SOPs accurately

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Uses good judgement

* Takes initiative when appropriate

* Is dependable and responsive

* Is comfortable working with spreadsheets and business data

* Is confident conducting detailed online research

* Is comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT

* Communicates professionally with customers, tenants, suppliers and colleagues

* Notices errors, inconsistencies or missing information rather than simply processing what is placed in front of them

* Is interested in developing a genuine long-term working relationship with our businesses



Previous remote administrative experience is preferred.



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* A reliable high-speed internet connection

* A modern computer suitable for remote administrative work

* A quiet and professional workspace

* Reliable access to WhatsApp

* The ability to work with Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365 applications



Experience with any of the following would be advantageous but is not essential:



* Microsoft Excel

* Microsoft Outlook

* Microsoft Teams

* Trello

* Shopify

* Xero

* Meta Business Suite

* Canva



We do not expect the successful candidate to already know all of our systems. The ability to learn quickly, follow instructions and work accurately is more important.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



This is a remote monthly-retainer position, not a conventional full-time hourly position.



The successful candidate must be available and responsive during agreed working periods aligned with our business hours in Grenada (Atlantic Standard Time).



Because the workload fluctuates, there will be periods requiring substantial support and other periods when considerably less work is required.



We are looking for someone who understands and is comfortable with this type of working arrangement.



COMPENSATION



Compensation will be agreed as a fixed monthly retainer.



Please state your expected monthly retainer in your application.



WORK SAMPLE EXERCISE – REQUIRED



We receive a high volume of applications and do not shortlist candidates based on CVs alone.



To be considered for this position, you must complete and submit the Work Sample Exercise provided with this job advertisement as part of your initial application.



The exercise contains practical tasks representative of the work involved in this position, including prioritisation, written communication, supplier research, meeting transcription, spreadsheet/data work and the use of AI.



Please do not submit an application without the completed Work Sample Exercise. Incomplete applications will not be considered.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit all of the following:



1. Your CV.



2. A cover letter including:



   * Your city and country.

   * Your internet download and upload speeds.

   * Your expected monthly retainer in US dollars.

   * A brief explanation of why this particular working arrangement and position interest you.

   * Details of any other ongoing employment, freelance clients or regular work commitments you currently have.



3. Your completed Work Sample Exercise.



Please include the word Grenada somewhere in your cover letter to confirm that you have read the entire job advertisement and application instructions carefully.



We are not looking for the applicant who can send us the longest CV.



We are looking for someone who is capable, dependable, resourceful, responsive and exceptionally good at getting things done.

We are a US-based insurance pre-licensing and continuing education company approved in 50 states. We help thousands of new insurance agents pass their state licensing exams. Our team is remote, mostly Philippines-based, and has been together for years. We invest in people who stay.

, chat, and ticket about course access, exam requirements, certificates, and state licensing steps. You will work inside our LMS (Absorb) and CRM (GoHighLevel) daily.



This is a regulated industry. Every state has its own rules about seat time, attendance, exam eligibility, and certificate issuance. Getting these wrong is not a small mistake, it can put our state approvals at risk. We need someone who follows the documented process exactly and asks before improvising.



What You'll Do



Respond to student inquiries by
 and live chat within our response time targets

Troubleshoot course access, login, and progress-tracking issues in the LMS

Verify student eligibility for certificates against state-specific requirements

Track and log Zoom webinar attendance accurately

Escalate anything you are unsure about instead of guessing

Keep detailed notes on every student interaction

Follow and help improve our written SOPs



What We're Looking For



2+ years in customer support, preferably US-facing

Excellent written and spoken English, professional and warm, no template-sounding replies

Detail-oriented to an unusual degree. You double-check before you send.

Comfortable saying "let me verify that" instead of making something up

Experience with an LMS, CRM, or helpdesk software (Absorb, GoHighLevel, Intercom, Zendesk, etc.)

Reliable internet and a quiet work environment

Available during US East Coast business hours



Nice to Have



Any exposure to insurance, financial services, or regulated education

Spanish fluency



Why Work With Us



Stable, long-term role with a company that has been operating since 2017

Paid time off and performance raises

Direct access to leadership, no layers of management

Real training, not sink-or-swim



How to Apply



Do not send a generic application. Applications that ignore these steps are deleted.



Start your message with the word PRECISION so I know you read this



In 3 to 5 sentences, describe a time you caught a mistake before it reached a customer. What was it, and how did you catch it?



Answer this: A student
s saying they finished their course and needs their certificate today because their exam is tomorrow. You check the system and their attendance log is missing one required session. What do you do?



Tell me your monthly salary expectation in USD

title: Interior Design Assist
description:
Lead Interiors Sourcing & Procurement Coordinator



Pay: $650/month (Full-Time)

Duration: 3 Months (Intensive Phase) with potential for long-term extension.

Reports to: Studio Manager / Christina Rhodes 



The Mission

We are in the high-velocity restoration phase of a 200-year-old British Barn—a heritage project that blends British history with a "Fairytale" aesthetic. We need a visually elite, technically proficient Sourcing Coordinator to take Christina’s mood boards and floor plans and translate them into a fully costed, actionable procurement engine.



Key Responsibilities:

Visual-to-Volume Translation: Read 2D/3D floor plans and technical drawings to calculate precise quantities for heritage materials (stone, timber, fabric, hardware).



High-Velocity Sourcing: Research and find 3–5 "on-brand" options for everything from cast-iron radiators to antique brass handles within 24-48 hours of a brief.



The Canva Selection Decks: Create well visually pleasing Canva decks for Christina’s review. Each slide must include the visual, purchase link, lead time, and total cost (including shipping/VAT). 



Budget Management: Maintain the Master Procurement Tracker (Google Sheets, provided to you). You are responsible for ensuring every choice fits within our financial plan or clearly shows how over/under budget it is. 



Lead Time Guarding: We have a strict 60-day window for major decisions. You will track shipping timelines to ensure the project stays on schedule.





Requirements



Technical Skill: Must be able to read and interpret architectural floor plans/layouts.



Platform Mastery: Expert-level Canva (for decks) and Google Sheets (for tracking).



The "Eye": An innate understanding of the aesthetic. You understand the difference between modern minimalism and British heritage. 



Availability: Full-time (40 hours/week) for an initial 3-month contract. We move fast; you must be available for quick-turnaround requests during UK working hours.



Why this role?

You will be working at the heart of an iconic brand build. While this starts as a 3-month intensive project, we are building a long-term "Heritage House." title: Etsy Digital Product Designer & Shop Builder – Small Business Forms & Template Bundles
description:
I am building a new Etsy shop focused on digital products that help small service-based businesses run more professionally and efficiently.



I am looking for a creative, organized, and experienced person who can help me build the shop from the ground up, including product research, template creation, branding, mockups, Etsy listings, and SEO.



The shop will offer both individual business forms/templates and larger coordinated bundles or complete operational systems. Customers may be able to purchase one specific document they need or save by purchasing a larger package containing multiple related forms.



The initial business niches will include:



Professional Organizing

Residential Cleaning

Pet Sitting / Dog Walking

Mobile Auto Detailing

Photography

Home Staging

Event Planning



Additional small-business niches will be added over time.



Types of Products We Will Create



Products may be sold individually, as smaller themed bundles, or as complete business systems.



Examples include:



Client intake forms

Lead inquiry forms

Consultation questionnaires

Client assessments

Service agreements

Contract templates

Proposal templates

Estimate and quote templates

Pricing guides

Service menus

Welcome packets

Client onboarding forms

Client preparation guides

Policies and procedures

Scheduling forms

Service checklists

Project checklists

Client communication templates

 templates

Follow-up forms

Cancellation and rescheduling policies

Payment policy forms

Client feedback forms

Review request templates

Referral forms

Offboarding documents

Internal workflow templates

Business trackers

Client management forms

Business organization templates



For example, a professional organizer may be able to purchase a Client Intake Form individually, a Client Onboarding Bundle containing several related documents, or a much larger Professional Organizer Business Forms Bundle containing most of the documents needed to manage clients from inquiry through project completion.



The goal is to give customers options at different price points while also creating larger, higher-value bundles.



Your Responsibilities



You will help:



Research each business niche and determine which forms and templates business owners are actively looking for

Identify opportunities for both individual products and bundles

Create professional editable templates, primarily in Canva

Develop coordinated collections so individual products can later be combined into bundles

Create clean, attractive, easy-to-use business documents

Maintain consistent branding and formatting across product collections

Create Etsy listing images and professional mockups

Prepare customer instruction PDFs and Canva template links

Create Etsy SEO titles, descriptions, and 13 tags

Research competitors and Etsy search opportunities

Recommend new products based on demand and gaps in the market

Help organize the Etsy shop into logical sections and product categories

Help develop larger premium bundles from individual products



I want the product catalog built strategically so that one form can become several selling opportunities.



For example:



Client Intake Form ? Client Onboarding Bundle ? Complete Business Forms Bundle



This will allow us to create a large Etsy catalog while also offering customers multiple purchasing options.



The Person I Am Looking For



You should be very comfortable using Canva and have a strong eye for professional, attractive business-document design.



Etsy experience is strongly preferred, especially experience with:



Digital products

Etsy SEO

Etsy keyword research

Canva templates

Small-business documents

Printable forms

Business systems

Client onboarding materials



Strong written English is important because many of these products will contain customer-facing business language.



You should also be extremely organized. We will be creating many related products, and documents need to be designed so they can work both individually and as part of larger coordinated bundles.



I am especially interested in someone who can research, think strategically, and suggest products, rather than waiting for me to provide every idea.



Product Research Is Important



I do not want someone who only knows how to make attractive Canva templates.



I want someone who can help answer questions such as:



What forms does a residential cleaning business actually need?

What documents are photographers searching for?

What forms are selling individually on Etsy?

Which products should be combined into bundles?

Which business niches have good demand but less competition?

What important forms are competitors leaving out?

How can we create a better or more complete product?



The goal is to create products that solve real operational problems for small-business owners.



Original Work Only



All work must be original and created specifically for this shop.



I do not want:



Copied Etsy listings

Copied competitor templates

Resold PLR products

Copyrighted designs

Templates purchased elsewhere and slightly modified



Any fonts, graphics, photos, icons, or design assets used must be appropriate for commercial use.



For contracts, legal forms, waivers, or other documents that could create legal obligations, templates should be clearly presented as customizable business templates and not represented as attorney-prepared legal advice unless they have actually been reviewed by a qualified attorney.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is not intended to be a one-time project.



My goal is to build a large Etsy digital-product shop containing potentially hundreds of listings across multiple small-business niches.



The shop will include:



Individual Forms ? Small Bundles ? Client Systems ? Complete Business Bundles



If we work well together, there will be ongoing work creating additional products, adding new industries, improving listings, creating bundles, researching keywords, and expanding the shop.



I am looking for someone who is interested in helping me build and grow the business long term.



To Apply



Please include the following:



A short introduction about your experience.

Examples of Canva templates, business documents, Etsy digital products, or forms you have created.

Details about any Etsy shops you have helped create or manage.

Your experience with Etsy SEO and keyword/product research.

Your experience creating digital products.

Your hourly rate and/or project rate.

How many hours per week you are available.

Which niche you would recommend we launch first: professional organizing, residential cleaning, pet sitting, mobile detailing, photography, home staging, or event planning.

Give me 5 individual digital products you would create first for that niche.

At the very top of your application, write “DIGITAL FORMS” so I know you read the entire posting.



Please do not send a generic application.



I am looking for someone who understands how to build a digital-product catalog strategically, where products can be sold individually and then combined into increasingly valuable bundles and complete business systems.

title: Travel Community Manager (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
**JOB TYPE:** Part-time, 20 hrs/week

**SALARY:** $450–650 USD/month, depending on experience

**COMPANY:** Vohana DMC





**ABOUT US**



Vohana DMC is a destination management company in Hawai'i. We handle the ground side of travel across O'ahu, Maui, Kaua'i, and the Big Island — operator relationships, bookings, on-island logistics — for travel advisors whose clients are heading to the islands. The advisor designs the trip. We make it actually happen once their client lands.



We're growing our presence in the US travel advisor community, where thousands of independent advisors sell Hawai'i without a dedicated partner on the ground here. We want to be the Hawai'i partner they think of first.



**THE ROLE**



You'll be our voice in the travel advisor community. You'll spend your time in forums and groups where advisors ask questions, share problems, and look for help — and you'll be the person who shows up, joins the conversation, and is genuinely useful.



Here's the important part: **you don't need to already know Hawai'i.** We live here. When an advisor asks something you can't answer, you bring it to us, we give you the real answer, and you take it back to the conversation. Over time you'll build serious Hawai'i knowledge — but it comes from us, not from you inventing it.



What we're hiring for is the personality and the consistency. Someone who's curious, likable in writing, asks good questions, and shows up every week.



**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



- Be active daily in travel advisor forums and groups — reading, replying, joining conversations

- Answer Hawai'i questions using knowledge we give you; ask us when you don't know

- Study the islands consistently: hotels, activities, seasons, what makes each island different

- Notice which advisors are working on Hawai'i trips and start real relationships with them

- Flag good opportunities to us so we can follow up

- Keep simple notes on who you're talking to and what they need

- Make occasional light visuals in Canva

- Learn our DESK booking platform (we'll train you)



**WHO THIS IS FOR**



Someone a little obsessed with travel. You read hotel reviews for fun and you'd happily fall down a research rabbit hole about Kaua'i's north shore. You're warm and natural in writing — people reply to you. You're not afraid to say "let me find out" instead of bluffing.



**WHO THIS IS NOT FOR**



This is a remote role based in the Philippines. There is no travel involved. If you're applying hoping for trips to Hawai'i, this isn't it. We need someone who loves the *industry* — the hotels, the itineraries, the craft of putting a trip together.



Also not for you if you go quiet. This role only works if you show up consistently and stay in touch with us.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- Excellent, natural written English — you sound like a person, not a brochure

- Genuinely interested in travel and hospitality

- Self-directed. Most of your work happens while Hawai'i is asleep

- Comfortable asking questions rather than guessing

- Google Workspace, Canva, and comfortable with AI tools for research

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace



**NICE TO HAVE**



- Travel, hospitality, or tourism background

- Community management, forum moderation, or social media experience

- Experience with a CRM



**SCHEDULE & PAY**



- 20 hrs/week, mostly async on your own schedule

- A few fixed check-in hours weekly overlapping Hawai'i time

- $450–650 USD/month

- Performance bonus available once you're up and running

- Long-term role with room to grow to full-time as the channel scales



**HOW TO APPLY**



Start your application with the word **HONU** so I know you read this.



Then answer briefly:



1. What travel brand, blog, or creator do you follow closely, and what do they do well?

2. Tell us about an online community you've been genuinely active in — any kind, doesn't have to be work. What did you post about?

3. What's your available start date and weekly schedule?



Applications without the codeword or without answers to all three questions won't be reviewed.

Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Why You'll Want This Role

Over time, it builds up to a stronger and more honest profile of who someone is, beyond what resumes and other profiles can share about a person today. My goal here is a more authentic world... and it starts with play!

It could also involve clipping video content, helping source for influencers to set up an ambassador program, or coming up with and shipping specific experiences to different audiences. 



In terms of collaboration: I'm happy to figure out a schedule that works for both of us. We can probably start with a short paid work trial - either part time or full time. Eventually the goal is to grow this into a consistent either part-time or full-time role. 



In terms of working with me, I'm someone who is reasonably relaxed and not micro-manage-y, but very detail-oriented. I am absolutely a perfectionist. To learn more about me, you can find some of our other job posts on the official website and that should give you a sense of the kind of company I'm building.

Thank you!

description:
At Rise Up Kings, we empower men to reach their full potential in faith, family, fitness, and finance. Behind the scenes, we run world-class systems to ensure our events, digital presence, and customer experience operate at the highest level. We are seeking an experienced Financial Controller to lead our accounting and financial operations. You'll be the backbone of our financial integrity, managing all accounting functions, financial reporting, and compliance for a growing organization that runs 70+ transformational events annually and serves 35+ team members. This is a strategic role where you'll own our books, ensure accuracy across all financial systems, and provide insights that drive business decisions.



We're a values-driven company (Real, Integrity, Serve, Excellence, Unwavering Faith, Passion) with a mission to transform 100,000 lives by 2034. You'll work in a culture that prizes excellence, accountability, and direct communication. This role is ideal for someone who loves precision, takes ownership, and wants to be part of a team that's building something meaningful.

- Own all accounting functions: accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close

- Prepare accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)

- Maintain QuickBooks Online as the primary accounting system; ensure data integrity and proper categorization

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and balance sheet accounts monthly with zero tolerance for discrepancies

- Manage accounts payable and receivable aging, collections, and vendor relationships

- Prepare financial reports and dashboards for leadership review and strategic decision-making



*Compliance & Controls*

- Ensure all financial transactions comply with U.S. GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles)

- Maintain internal controls and audit trails; implement best practices to prevent fraud and errors

- Prepare and file tax documents and support tax planning with external CPAs

- Manage payroll processing via Gusto; ensure accurate and timely employee payments and tax withholdings

- Track and reconcile corporate credit card expenses (Ramp); enforce expense policy compliance



*Systems & Process Optimization*

- Manage integrations between QuickBooks Online, Gusto, Ramp, and other financial tools

- Identify process inefficiencies and implement solutions to streamline accounting workflows

- Document and maintain SOPs for all financial processes to ensure consistency and knowledge transfer

- Recommend and implement accounting software upgrades or new tools as the company scales



*Strategic Support*

title: Phone Support Representative — Subscription Retention
description:
Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

About the Role



We are a growing US subscription brand building our Phone Support & Retention Team from the ground up.



You'll spend your day speaking directly with American customers—many of whom are calling because they want to cancel their subscription, pause their account, or request a refund.



Your job isn't simply to read a script and process a ticket.



You'll need to have a genuine conversation, understand why the customer wants to leave, and use approved retention offers to give them a reason to stay.



When you save a customer, that's a win. When you can't, you'll professionally process their cancellation or refund while they're still on the phone, accurately and without letting a difficult interaction affect the way you treat them.



This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, comfortable handling objections, and able to stay calm when customers are frustrated.



???? Growth Opportunity



This is a brand-new team, and we intend to promote our first Customer Service Manager from the people hired in this round.



If you're interested in growing into a leadership role, tell us in your application.



## What You'll Do



* Take inbound calls from US customers requesting cancellations, pauses, or refunds

* Ask the right questions to understand the customer's actual reason for leaving

* Handle objections and negotiate using approved retention offers

* Offer appropriate solutions such as:



  * Skip a shipment

  * Change subscription frequency

  * Apply an approved discount

  * Downgrade the subscription

  * Offer an approved free product

* Process cancellations and refunds directly in Shopify during the live call

* Accurately document every interaction in Zendesk

* Select the correct call outcome and reason codes

* Escalate issues quickly when they fall outside your authority

* Meet retention, refund accuracy, productivity, and call quality targets



## Requirements



Must-Have



* Fluent spoken English with clear, natural communication that American customers can easily understand

* Proven phone support experience with US customers

* Experience handling live voice calls — chat/email-only experience does not qualify

* Hands-on Shopify experience



  * Finding customer orders

  * Processing refunds

  * Managing cancellations/subscriptions

* Previous experience in customer retention, saves, objection handling, or sales

* Experience using a CRM/helpdesk platform



  * Zendesk preferred

  * Richpanel, Gorgias, or similar platforms are also acceptable

* Able to speak with customers while navigating systems and documenting information accurately

* Comfortable handling angry, frustrated, or demanding customers

* Strong attention to detail when processing refunds and cancellations

* Reliable wired internet connection

* Backup internet/power solution

* Quiet, professional workspace

* Good-quality noise-cancelling headset

* Willingness to work the required EST night shift long term



? Bonus Points



* Experience with Checkout Champ

* Experience with 
, Konnektive, ReCharge, or LimeLight

* Background working for a DTC or subscription-based brand

* Chargeback prevention or dispute handling experience

* Previous experience working specifically in **subscription retention



Who Will Do Well in This Role?



You don't get rattled when a customer says  “No.”

You know how to ask one more question without being pushy.

You don't take cancellations personally, and you don't become defensive when someone is rude.

You're able to protect company policies while still sounding like a real person - not a robot reading a script.



You know how to negotiate, listen, and identify what a customer actually needs.

title: Trade Services Coordinator
description:
Location: Manila City, Philippines

Work arrangement: Full-time, work from home initially, transitioning to our future Manila City office



Reports to: Philippines Office Manager



About Elite Trades Australia

Elite Trades Australia is a Melbourne-based electrical and plumbing services company delivering residential, commercial, government, maintenance and energy-efficiency projects across Victoria. Our work includes electrical and plumbing services, hot-water and heat-pump installations, property upgrades, maintenance and project delivery.

We coordinate internal field teams and subcontractors through disciplined job-management, scheduling, compliance and documentation systems. Accuracy, ownership and timely escalation are essential to keeping our field operations running effectively.



About the Role



Elite Trades Australia is seeking an experienced and highly organised Service Coordinator to manage the end-to-end coordination of electrical, plumbing, HVAC and energy-efficiency works.



This is a key operational role responsible for ensuring jobs are accurately created, scheduled, dispatched, completed, documented and progressed to invoicing without unnecessary delays. The successful candidate will act as the central point of coordination between customers, field technicians, subcontractors, retailers, property managers, suppliers and internal departments.



This role requires strong ownership, excellent communication and the ability to maintain control of a busy, constantly changing schedule.



Key Responsibilities

Manage jobs from receipt of a purchase order or confirmed booking through to completion and invoice readiness.

Create accurate job cards in ServiceM8 on the same business day, including all customer, property, retailer, purchase-order and scope information.

Maintain a forward schedule and ensure work is planned efficiently according to priority, location, technician availability, trade licences, required skills and material availability.

Allocate work to employees and subcontractors while maximising productivity, travel efficiency and first-time completion.

Confirm appointments, site access requirements and job details with customers before attendance.

Provide field teams with complete job information, including scope, access instructions, supporting documents, compliance requirements and allocated materials.

Monitor daily job progress and respond promptly to cancellations, delays, access issues, technician absences, stock shortages and urgent requests.

Communicate professionally with customers, retailers, property managers, suppliers, technicians and other stakeholders.

Keep customers and stakeholders informed of appointment changes, delays, required follow-up work and expected completion timeframes.

Maintain accurate job statuses, notes, communications and supporting records in ServiceM8 as the primary operational system.

Review completed jobs to confirm that required photographs, forms, signatures, certificates, serial numbers, variations and compliance documents have been submitted.

Identify incomplete or non-compliant job documentation and follow up with field staff immediately.

Coordinate return visits, warranty matters, defects, customer complaints and outstanding works through to resolution.

Confirm stock and equipment availability with the warehouse team before scheduling work.

Record approved variations and additional works accurately and ensure they are communicated to the relevant parties.

Identify completed jobs that have not progressed to invoicing and resolve any documentation or approval issues causing delays.

Monitor overdue, pending and stalled jobs and provide management with clear updates, risks and recommended actions.

Escalate safety, compliance, customer, operational or commercial risks promptly.

Support field staff with scheduling, site information and operational issues without compromising customer service.

Assist with emergency and high-priority service requests when required.

Contribute to improvements in scheduling, customer communication, documentation and operational processes.

Maintain confidentiality and comply with company policies, safety requirements and applicable industry standards.



Key Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured through:

Accurate and timely creation of job cards.

Maintaining a reliable forward work schedule.

On-time attendance and job completion rates.

Efficient utilisation of field staff and subcontractors.

Accuracy of ServiceM8 records and job statuses.

Reduction in missed appointments, scheduling errors and unnecessary return visits.

Timely collection of completion and compliance documentation.

Prompt progression of completed jobs to invoicing.

Effective management of outstanding and ageing jobs.

Stakeholder response times and customer satisfaction.

Professional handling and resolution of complaints and escalations.



Skills and Experience

At least two years’ experience in service coordination, scheduling, dispatch, customer service or field-service administration.

Experience within electrical, plumbing, HVAC, construction, facilities management or another trade-service environment is strongly preferred.

Proven ability to coordinate a high volume of jobs, technicians and changing priorities.

Strong customer-service and stakeholder-management skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication.

High attention to detail and commitment to accurate recordkeeping.

Ability to remain calm, organised and solutions-focused under pressure.

Strong judgement when prioritising urgent work and escalating operational risks.

Confidence handling complaints, delays and difficult conversations professionally.

Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and cloud-based job-management systems.

Experience with ServiceM8, AroFlo, simPRO or similar field-service software is highly desirable.

Understanding of trade licences, safety documentation and job-completion requirements is advantageous.

Experience with VEU works, compliance documentation or government-funded maintenance programs will be highly regarded.



Personal Attributes



The ideal candidate will be:

Accountable and willing to take ownership of outcomes.

Proactive rather than waiting for problems to escalate.

Highly organised and disciplined with follow-ups.

Clear, respectful and confident in communication.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced operational environment.

Focused on accuracy, customer service and continuous improvement.

Capable of balancing the needs of customers, technicians and commercial stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like



A successful Service Coordinator keeps the operation under control: technicians know where they are going and what they are doing, customers remain informed, job records are accurate, documentation is complete, problems are addressed early, and completed work progresses to invoicing without avoidable delays.

This role is not about selling on social media. Your job is to build a credible local brand, earn attention from law firm decision-makers and their referral networks, and drive organic traffic to the True Cloud AI website through helpful, educational content.



You will translate technical IT and cybersecurity topics into clear, practical content that helps law firm owners, office managers, and attorneys understand risk, productivity, and compliance — without jargon or scare tactics.
