title: AI & Systems Integration Specialist
description:
Cooper Roofing Inc.

AI & Systems Integration Specialist



Location: Remote (Philippines preferred). Applicants must maintain at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours. Five to eight hours of overlap is ideal.



Connect the Systems That Will Power Our Growth



Cooper Roofing is an award-winning residential, commercial, and builder-focused roofing company serving Greater Vancouver and the Lower Mainland. We believe a modern roofing company should be organized, technology-driven, and committed to continuously improving the experience of both its customers and employees.







Our business currently operates across more than 20 software platforms, and many integration and automation decisions are still managed directly by our Founder and CEO. As we work toward our goal of becoming a $10 million company, we need a technical specialist who can connect our systems, eliminate unnecessary manual work, and build a scalable technology foundation.







The AI & Systems Integration Specialist will take ownership of Cooper Roofing's technology stack from end to end. This is not a general virtual assistant position and is not intended for a marketer who has only built a few basic Zapier automations. You will serve as the architect responsible for understanding how our systems, workflows, teams, and data connect. You will audit our existing tools, interview employees about their daily processes, identify inefficiencies, recommend consolidation opportunities, and build reliable integrations using platforms such as Zapier, 
, and n8n. The role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and works closely with the Marketing Strategist, web developer, and employees throughout the company.







Key Responsibilities



Create and maintain a complete inventory of company software, including each tool's purpose, owner, cost, data, and integrations.

Meet with employees across sales, estimating, administration, production, project management, marketing, and leadership to document workflows and pain points.

Recommend which tools should be retained, replaced, consolidated, or eliminated.

Establish and protect a reliable source of truth for customer and job data within JobNimbus, GoHighLevel, or the appropriate system.

Build and maintain integrations using Zapier, 
, n8n, APIs, webhooks, and custom workflows.

Monitor automation health and resolve failed Zaps, scenarios, webhooks, and data transfers before they affect operations.

Develop AI-assisted estimate and proposal drafting workflows based on job information or photographs.

Automate customer follow-up sequences based on JobNimbus stages.

Integrate call transcription and summaries with customer and job records.

Develop lead-scoring systems using historical sales and closing data.

Build AI-assisted review-response workflows that require human approval before publishing.

Automate the creation of advertising and landing-page variations for the Marketing Strategist to test.

Create content-repurposing workflows across multiple formats and platforms.

Develop scheduling-conflict alerts involving crews, weather, and material deliveries.

Automate the organization of crew photographs and documents into the correct job files.

Build material-ordering triggers connected to job stages and supplier processes.

Automate warranty, callback, and service-reminder tracking.

Connect job-completion stages with invoicing and QuickBooks workflows.

Develop alerts for duplicate invoices, unusual transactions, and other accounting anomalies.

Create automated weekly financial summaries using QuickBooks data.

Automate new-hire onboarding, account setup, documentation, and training checklists.

Build an internal knowledge base or SOP assistant that helps employees answer routine questions.

Create dashboards connecting JobNimbus, QuickBooks, advertising spend, leads, and closed revenue.

Develop proactive alerts for changes such as rising cost per lead, declining close rates, or unusual performance.

Manage integration credentials and access through a shared password manager.

Maintain process maps, system documentation, SOPs, and written offboarding procedures.





Qualifications



Previous experience in IT administration, systems administration, technical operations, automation engineering, or systems integration.

Hands-on experience with at least two of the following platforms: Zapier, 
, and n8n.

Strong preference for candidates with practical n8n experience.

Experience administering a CRM rather than simply using one.

Experience with GoHighLevel, JobNimbus, or a comparable CRM is preferred.

Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, authentication methods, and JSON.

Ability to create custom integrations when a native connector is unavailable.

Experience connecting QuickBooks or another accounting platform with operational systems.

Experience managing or improving a multi-platform technology stack.

Strong documentation habits and the ability to create clear SOPs and process maps.

Excellent written English and the ability to explain technical processes to non-technical employees.

Strong attention to security, credential management, data accuracy, and access controls.

Direct experience using OpenAI, Anthropic, or another large-language-model API is an asset.

Ability to work independently, investigate technical problems, and recommend solutions based on cost, complexity, reliability, and business value.





Pay and Benefits



Full-time independent contractor position.

Base salary: USD $1,000-$1,500 per month, paid bi-weekly, depending on technical experience, systems integration expertise, and demonstrated ability 

Thirteenth-month bonus for candidates based in the Philippines; an equivalent structure may be discussed for candidates located elsewhere.

Direct working relationship with the Founder and CEO.

Significant ownership of the company's technology and automation strategy.

Opportunity to design systems that will support Cooper Roofing's growth.

Exposure to systems across sales, marketing, estimating, production, finance, human resources, and customer service.

Ongoing professional development within a company that values learning and continuous improvement.

Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid technical assessment as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must be able to consistently provide at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours, with five to eight hours being ideal. Because this position will have near-administrator access to important company systems, finalists should also expect comprehensive reference and background checks upon a conditional offer.





Why Cooper Roofing?



At Cooper Roofing, technology is not treated as an afterthought; it is a critical part of how we plan to grow without adding unnecessary complexity and administrative work. You will have the opportunity to build systems with a visible, company-wide impact and solve meaningful operational problems across every department. We value people who take initiative, document their work, continue learning, and challenge inefficient ways of operating. This is a chance to become the trusted technical owner of a growing company's entire digital ecosystem.







Cooper Roofing encourages applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.



PLEASE SEND THE APPLICATION IN THE FOLLOWING LINK: CooperRoofing.discovered.ai/job-details/68615

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant
description:
$5–$7 USD/hour | Long-Term Position | Growth Opportunity



We are looking for a smart, dependable, highly organized Virtual Assistant who wants to become a long-term part of our team.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks and waits for the next instruction. We want someone who takes ownership, follows through, thinks ahead, brings ideas, and helps us improve the way we operate.



You do not need to know everything when you start. We will train the right person. What matters most is that you are intelligent, resourceful, dependable, comfortable with technology, and able to learn independently.



Prior appraisal experience is NOT required. We can teach you the appraisal-related portion of the position.



Responsibilities



You will assist with:



Typing and preparing appraisal-related reports and documents

Answering incoming business calls

Communicating professionally with homeowners, lenders, attorneys, real estate professionals, and other clients

Scheduling appraisal appointments

Responding to appraisal bid requests

Negotiating fees and turn times within company guidelines

Managing
s, calendars, orders, files, and client follow-ups

Keeping track of outstanding items and following up without needing to be reminded

Helping organize and improve company systems and workflows

Using ChatGPT and other technology to improve productivity

Assisting with website, marketing, advertising, and business improvement projects as needed



Again, appraisal experience is not required. We are willing to train someone who demonstrates strong learning ability, attention to detail, initiative, professionalism, and reliability.



Schedule & Availability



This position requires consistent availability during U.S. Central Time (CT) business hours.



Work schedules will generally fall within one of the following shifts:



8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CT

9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CT

10:00 AM – 7:00 PM CT



The specific schedule will be determined based on company needs and discussed during the hiring process.



Because this position includes answering business calls, communicating with clients, scheduling appointments, and handling time-sensitive matters, applicants must be able to reliably and consistently work their assigned Central Time schedule.



Computer & Workstation Requirements



Because this position involves working with multiple programs, documents, websites,
s, appraisal software, and other systems at the same time, you must already have an appropriate workstation.



You must have:



A reliable computer capable of handling your daily workload

At least two computer monitors/screens that can be used together as one workstation

Reliable high-speed internet

A working microphone and audio setup for calls and meetings

A dependable backup plan for internet or power outages



A desktop computer plus a completely separate laptop that cannot function as a second connected display does NOT meet the two-screen requirement.



You must be able to work across at least two screens simultaneously from the same workstation.



Please do not apply if you do not currently meet this requirement.



We Want Someone Who Contributes



We do not want someone who does something a certain way simply because “that’s how it has always been done.”



If you notice a better, faster, more organized, or more efficient way to do something, we want you to tell us.



We want someone who:



Takes ownership of assignments from beginning to completion

Follows up without being asked

Notices when something still needs attention

Thinks ahead

Identifies problems and suggests solutions

Brings new ideas to the company

Researches better ways of doing things

Is comfortable respectfully recommending changes

Wants to help the company grow, not simply complete tasks



If you are given responsibility for something, we should not have to continuously remind you that it still needs to be completed.



We want someone who develops their own system for keeping track of responsibilities, deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding items.



AI & Technology



You do not need to be an AI expert.



However, you must be comfortable learning new technology and figuring things out independently.



We may ask you to research ChatGPT, AI tools, automation, websites, marketing systems, software, or other technology that could help our business.



We want someone who can research it, learn it, test it, help implement it, and then come back and clearly teach us how to use it.



If you encounter something you do not know how to do, your first response should not always be, “I don't know how.”



We value people who are willing to research, troubleshoot, learn, and attempt to find a solution.



If you are carefully reading this job posting, use the exact subject line “Michael Jackson Is Dancing” when submitting your application.



You Should Be

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Reliable and consistent

Strong in written and spoken English

Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based clients by phone

Professional and confident

Able to work independently

A strong problem solver

Comfortable learning new technology

Able to follow instructions carefully

Proactive and willing to take initiative

Comfortable receiving feedback

Interested in a long-term position and growing with one company

Able to consistently work during your assigned U.S. Central Time schedule

Able to manage multiple responsibilities and follow-ups without constant supervision



Experience with customer service, executive assistance, real estate, mortgage, scheduling, ChatGPT, websites, marketing, CRM systems, or automation is a plus.



Appraisal experience is a plus but is NOT required.



Pay & Growth



Starting pay is $5–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



We plan to conduct a performance review after approximately 90 days. Strong performance, increased independence, and greater responsibility can lead to increased compensation and advancement.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the company over the long term.



How to Apply



Please answer each of the following questions:



Briefly introduce yourself and describe your work experience.

Describe your experience answering phones and communicating with clients.

Tell us about your experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools. Limited experience is okay.

Give one example of something you did not know how to do but successfully researched and learned on your own.

Tell us about a time you noticed something at work that could be done better. What did you recommend or change?

If you were assigned something that required follow-up several days later, how would you make sure it was completed without your manager reminding you?

Tell us about any experience with scheduling, negotiating, real estate, websites, marketing, or automation.

List the software and online tools you are comfortable using.

Describe your primary computer and workstation setup.

Confirm that you currently have at least two monitors/screens that can be used simultaneously as part of the same workstation.

Describe your internet connection and your backup plan for internet or power outages.

Which of the following Central Time schedules can you consistently work: 8 AM–5 PM, 9 AM–6 PM, or 10 AM–7 PM? Please list all that apply.

What hourly rate are you requesting between $5 and $7 USD/hour, and why?

Why are you interested in a long-term position?

Voice Recording Required



Along with your written application, please send a short voice recording introducing yourself and briefly discussing your work experience.



This position requires regular communication with U.S.-based clients by phone, so the voice recording will help us evaluate spoken English, communication style, professionalism, clarity, and comfort speaking.



Applications submitted without the requested voice recording may not receive further consideration.



Interview Process & Typing Test



Candidates whose applications appear to be a strong match may be invited to move forward to the interview stage.



If we d
 to move forward with you, we will provide a typing test that must be completed as part of the interview process.



The typing test is not required when initially submitting your application. Instructions will be provided directly to selected applicants.



Because a significant portion of this position involves typing, data entry,
s, documents, reports, and computer-based work, typing ability will be considered when evaluating candidates.



Professional References



Professional references are strongly preferred and may give an applicant stronger consideration.



If available, please provide 1–3 previous employers, supervisors, or long-term clients, including:



Name

Company

Your working relationship

 address

Phone number



Please only provide references who have given permission to be contacted.



If you are currently employed and do not want your current employer contacted, simply let us know.



Important:

Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste application.



We are looking for someone who reads carefully, follows instructions, communicates well, learns quickly, follows through, thinks independently, brings ideas, and genuinely wants to contribute to the growth of the company.



Before applying, make sure you:



Have read the entire job posting

Can work one of the listed Central Time schedules

Already have the required two-screen workstation

Are comfortable regularly speaking with clients by phone

Are willing to learn appraisal-related work

Have included your voice recording

Have answered all application questions

Have followed the special application instruction included elsewhere in this posting



If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

title: Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Billing Specialist
description:
Position: Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Billing Specialist



Starting Salary: PHP 45,000 per month, with opportunities for future growth and salary increases based on performance and increased responsibilities



Schedule: Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours



We are hiring an experienced Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Billing Specialist to support a growing U.S.-based healthcare organization.



Durable Medical Equipment includes medical equipment and supplies intended for ongoing patient use, such as wheelchairs, walkers, hospital beds, oxygen equipment, CPAP machines, and similar items.



The role will focus on DME insurance verification, documentation review, claim submission, denial resolution, payment posting, and accounts receivable follow-up.



Direct experience using TrueSight by Medbill is a major advantage and will receive priority consideration.



This is a long-term opportunity for an experienced DME billing professional who communicates clearly, takes ownership, solves problems, and follows every claim through payment or final resolution.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



• Minimum 2 years of hands-on DME or HME billing experience



• Experience billing Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance carriers



• Strong understanding of the complete DME billing and revenue-cycle process



• Knowledge of HCPCS codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, payer requirements, medical necessity, and DME documentation



• Experience with eligibility verification, prior authorizations, claim submission, denials, appeals, payment posting, and AR follow-up



• Ability to review prescriptions, physician orders, supporting documentation, and proof of delivery



• Strong outbound calling skills and confidence speaking with U.S.-based insurance representatives



• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills



• Strong organization, accuracy, documentation, and follow-through



• Ability to work independently and take ownership of claims until payment or final resolution



HIGHLY PREFERRED



• Direct experience using TrueSight by Medbill



Candidates with hands-on TrueSight experience should clearly identify this in their application and describe how they used the platform.



IMPORTANT



This is not a general medical billing, bookkeeping, accounts payable, virtual assistant, or basic data-entry position.



Applicants must have direct experience billing for Durable Medical Equipment. Candidates without relevant DME or HME billing experience may not be considered.



We need someone who understands the specialized documentation, coding, payer requirements, and follow-up involved in DME billing. The right candidate must be comfortable contacting insurance companies, investigating unpaid or denied claims, making corrections, and following up consistently until payment is received.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Verify patient eligibility, insurance benefits, and DME coverage



• Obtain and track prior authorizations when required



• Review prescriptions, physician orders, medical-necessity documentation, and proof of delivery



• Confirm that all billing information and supporting documentation are complete



• Apply the correct HCPCS codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, units, and payer information



• Prepare, review, and submit accurate DME claims



• Manage recurring rental, resupply, and other DME-specific billing when applicable



• Monitor rejected, denied, delayed, and underpaid claims



• Correct and resubmit claims and prepare appeals when necessary



• Post and reconcile payments, ERAs, EOBs, adjustments, and patient balances



• Monitor AR aging and follow up on outstanding claims



• Contact insurance companies by phone,
, and payer portals



• Obtain claim status, reference numbers, expected payment dates, required corrections, and clear next steps



• Document all calls, claim updates, responses, and follow-up dates



• Provide clear reports regarding claims, denials, collections, and outstanding AR



• Follow every assigned claim through payment or final resolution



TO APPLY, PLEASE SUBMIT



• Resume



• OnlineJobs Profile Link



• Number of years of direct DME or HME billing experience



• Types of DME products and insurance payers you have worked with



• List of DME billing, clearinghouse, insurance, and payer platforms you have used



• Details regarding any direct experience with TrueSight by Medbill



• Average number of claims or accounts you managed



• Average number of outbound payer follow-up calls you handled daily



• One example of a denied or unpaid DME claim you successfully resolved and the steps you took



• A short voice recording introducing yourself, summarizing your DME billing experience, and demonstrating how you would speak with an insurance representative regarding an unpaid or denied DME claim



Applications missing the requested information or voice recording may not be considered.



WORK SETUP



• Full-time, permanent remote position



• Philippines-based candidates only



• Must be available during U.S. business hours



• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup internet or power solution, and professional home-office environment required



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



• Starting salary of PHP 45,000 per month



• Opportunities for future salary increases based on performance, professional growth, increased responsibilities, and overall contribution



• Work from home



• Paid training



• Stable, long-term position



• Opportunities for advancement



We are looking for a highly capable Durable Medical Equipment Billing Specialist who combines strong technical billing knowledge with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and personal accountability.

Please do not apply unless you meet all of the following.



1. Pacific Time availability is required



Our company operates on Pacific Time — Los Angeles/Vancouver time.



Your required workdays are:



Monday–Friday + Sunday, Pacific Time



Saturday, Pacific Time, is generally off.



Your actual work schedule will fall somewhere within:



7:00 AM–9:00 PM Pacific Time



You will not work this entire 14-hour window.



This is simply the range of hours during which your assigned schedule may fall.



The position will be up to approximately 40 hours per week.



Your schedule may include:



• Full workdays Monday–Friday

• Lighter Sunday coverage

• Occasional schedule changes during launches, workshops and major events

• Occasional urgent tasks outside your normal shift



If you are based in the Philippines



Pacific Time corresponds to overnight and morning hours in the Philippines.



During U.S./Canadian daylight saving time:



7:00 AM Pacific ? 10:00 PM Philippines

9:00 PM Pacific ? 12:00 PM/noon Philippines the following day



Your actual shift would fall somewhere within that window.



You would not work from 10 PM until noon.



For Philippine-based candidates, working Monday–Friday + Sunday Pacific Time will generally translate to working approximately:



Tuesday–Saturday + Monday Philippine Time



with Sunday Philippine Time generally off, depending on your exact shift.



Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable maintaining this schedule long-term.



2. Exceptional spoken and written English is required



You must have native or near-native English proficiency.



Your spoken English must be:



• Extremely clear

• Fluent and natural

• Professional

• Easily understood by North American clients and team members

• Strong enough to confidently lead meetings and communicate with clients



Excellent written English, grammar and professional communication skills are equally important.



If you already have any videos, reels, interviews, presentations, teaching videos, social media clips or other examples of yourself speaking English, please include them with your application.



This is not required, but it is extremely helpful.



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in a group interview.



3. You must understand the dance industry

Ideal candidates may have experience as a:



• Former dancer

• Dance teacher

• Studio administrator

• Competition or convention employee

• Performing arts administrator

• Talent agency employee

• Entertainment industry professional

• Dance parent with significant industry experience

• Administrative or operations professional within dance or entertainment



You do not need to currently work professionally as a dancer.



In fact, this position is best suited for someone who wants to build a long-term career on the business and operations side of the dance and entertainment industry, rather than someone looking for temporary income while actively pursuing a full-time performance career.



4. Operations experience is required



You must have experience with some combination of:



• Executive assistance

• Business operations

• Project management

• Team coordination

• Administrative management

• Client service

• Systems and processes

• Deadline management

• Team accountability

• Event coordination

• Problem solving



This position goes well beyond traditional administrative work.

• Highly organized

• Proactive

• Assertive

• Resourceful

• Able to think several steps ahead

• Able to work independently

• Able to take complete ownership of responsibilities



You should be the type of person who notices:

and takes action before I have to ask.

This is not someone who only completes administrative tasks.



You need to be comfortable communicating with a team and saying:



“This deadline was missed. What is blocking it, and when will it be completed?”



You must be able to:

title: Clinical Medical Necessity & Prior Authorization Specialist (RN) - remote
description:
# Job Description: Clinical Medical Necessity & Prior Authorization Specialist (RN) – Remote



## Position Summary



We are seeking an experienced **Registered Nurse (RN)** with a strong background in **utilization management, medical necessity review, and prior authorizations** to join our growing interventional pain management and regenerative medicine practice. This is a fully remote position for a highly organized, analytical professional who enjoys reviewing complex medical records and ensuring that clinical documentation meets payer-specific medical necessity requirements.



The ideal candidate has previously worked for a **commercial insurance carrier, Medicare Advantage plan, utilization management company, or prior authorization department**, and understands how insurance reviewers evaluate requests for advanced procedures.



Rather than simply submitting authorizations, this role serves as a **clinical documentation consultant** by identifying gaps in documentation, cross-referencing payer policies, and helping providers optimize their notes before submission.



---



# Responsibilities



* Review patient charts for medical necessity prior to submission for insurance authorization.

* Analyze large medical records (100–500+ pages) and identify relevant clinical information.

* Compare provider documentation with payer-specific medical necessity criteria.

* Identify documentation deficiencies that could result in authorization denials.

* Recommend specific additions or revisions to provider documentation to strengthen medical necessity.

* Prepare comprehensive authorization packets for submission.

* Assist with first-level and second-level appeals following denials.

* Track payer-specific documentation requirements and maintain internal authorization checklists.

* Stay current with Medicare LCDs/NCDs and commercial payer policies.

* Communicate effectively with physicians, nurse practitioners, and authorization staff regarding documentation improvements.

* Maintain detailed tracking of authorization status, denials, appeals, and outcomes.

* Assist in developing standardized documentation templates to improve approval rates.



---



# Procedures Supported



Experience reviewing medical necessity for one or more of the following is strongly preferred:



* Stem Cell Procedures

* Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) Procedures

* Other Regenerative Medicine Procedures

* Pain Management Procedures



---



# Required Qualifications



* Active Registered Nurse (RN) license

* Minimum 5 years of clinical nursing experience

* Minimum 2 years of utilization management, medical necessity review, or prior authorization experience

* Previous employment with a commercial insurance company, Medicare Advantage plan, or utilization management organization strongly preferred

* Excellent understanding of medical terminology and clinical documentation

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Strong written communication skills

* Ability to work independently while managing multiple cases simultaneously



---



# Preferred Qualifications



Experience with:



* eClinicalWorks (eCW)

* InterQual Criteria



Clinical experience in one or more of the following specialties is highly desirable:



* Pain Management

* Orthopedic Surgery

* Neurosurgery

* Neurology

* Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation

* Interventional Spine

* Anesthesiology



---



# Desired Skills



The successful candidate will be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Highly organized

* Able to synthesize large amounts of clinical information quickly

* Comfortable reading imaging reports and specialist consultation notes

* Able to identify inconsistencies within medical records

* Skilled at translating payer requirements into actionable documentation recommendations

* Professional and collaborative when working with providers

* Passionate about improving first-pass authorization approval rates



---



# Performance Metrics



Success in this role will be measured by:



* First-pass authorization approval rate

* Reduction in insurance denials

* Appeal success rate

* Turnaround time for chart review

* Accuracy of medical necessity assessments

* Provider satisfaction with documentation recommendations

* Revenue protected through improved authorization outcomes



---



# Compensation



Compensation is competitive and will be based on experience.



Full-time and part-time applicants will be considered.



---



# Why Join Us?



Our practice specializes in advanced interventional pain management and regenerative medicine. You will work directly with physicians to improve documentation quality, increase insurance approval rates, and ensure patients receive medically necessary care without unnecessary delays.



This is an opportunity to become an integral member of a collaborative team where your expertise will directly impact patient access to care and practice success.

title: Short Form Video Editor - TikTok Shop
description:
Short Form Video Editor  - TikTok Shop



I am seeking a talented video editor with an eye for detail for recreating existing TikTok shop videos. The ideal candidate understands the importance of visual, verbal, and on screen text hooks, content that grabs attention and stops the scroll, keeping the viewer watching through quick cuts, zoom ins, and a strong call to action at the end of the video. You should also understand the value of subtly focusing on “engagement bait” and not editing out things that are intentionally out of place or odd that will get people engaging (commenting) on the post. 



In the beginning this will likely be roughly 10 hours a week but for the right candidate this could be a long term relationship, with the opportunity for many many more additional hours. (See below)



How it would work:



I will provide you with long 3-5 min unedited clips, and voice over files. I will then send you links of 3-5 example TikTok posts that have proven to go viral or earn sales. Your job will to be to take the provided clips and audio to recreate the videos that were sent by link. So you must have an eye for detail, the videos should be as close to the original as possible. 



Once I can see that you have grasped the editing style that is effective and we both understand what each other is looking for, that is when hours can increase to however much you would like to work. What that would look like is, me asking you to use your creative freedom to take previous created videos that have been proven successful and basically putting the clips in a different order to repurpose old content that is very similar without it being an identical recreation. 



Here are examples so you can see an example of the type video styles similar to the ones I will be asking for you to recreate:









You should have experience with 



- Short-form vertical videos (7 seconds to 45 seconds) with tight cuts, removing filler/dead air, quick pacing that holds retention

- Photo overlays

- Captions/subtitles

- On screen text



You're a strong fit if you:



1. Have a reel/portfolio of short form edits I can watch (not long form videos)

2. Have and understanding for super quick pacing and retention (you know how to stop the scroll) 

4. Can match an existing video rather than trying to create your own (I'll give you examples to recreate) including screenshotting and using photo overlays that are in the existing video.

5. Are reliable with deadlines and communicate proactively about timelines

6. Turn around revisions quickly and take feedback well

7. If you feel comfortable asking for something when is not there (for example if the inspiration video has a a section where the video or audio was not created, I want to be informed)



Tools



- Confident in Capcut or other video editor (vertical landscape edits for TikTok)

- Comfortable receiving large raw files via DropBox or Google Drive



Requirements

1. Editing computer that can handle 1080p/4K footage

2. Reliable internet with solid upload speed (you'll need to be able to move large files)

3. About 10 hrs/week availability, ongoing, with the ability for that to drastically increase

4. A reel or portfolio link with short-form work (required) 

5. Experience with short form content (it does not have to be TikTok shop content) if your only experience is long form content unfortunately you are not the candidate I am looking for. 



How to apply (read carefully)



Link your reel/portfolio, ideally with at least one short edit I can watch start to finish.



Pick ONE short-form edit in your portfolio and tell me, in 2–3 sentences, how you would change it based on what I am looking for.



List the editing software you use.



Tell me your typical turn around for 3-5 short videos (15 secs to 45 secs each) similar to the ones above.



What is your internet upload speed?



Start your message with the word [RETENTION] so I know you read this fully. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



I watch every reel from applicants who follow all of these steps. Please note your experience and resume is less important than your ability to quickly understand what I am looking for and your attention to small details to recreate a post. Excited to see your work!

title: Experienced Video Editor
description:
About Us

We're a global wellness technology group operating multiple consumer wellness brands, including a market-leading vibration/fitness equipment brand sold across the US, UK, EU, Australia, and Canada, and a sensory/vibroacoustic therapy products brand. We also have an emerging pet-therapy brand. Our content spans YouTube, organic social across multiple brand pages, trade show media, and direct-response marketing video.



We're bringing video editing in-house and are hiring a full-time editor to own this work directly, replacing an outsourced production arrangement.



About the Role

You'll be the primary video editor across our brand ecosystem — turning raw footage, presenter recordings, and stock/B-roll into polished content for YouTube, organic social (four+ brand pages), sales funnel videos, and trade show/marketing assets. You'll work closely with our Digital Operations team and content presenters to keep a consistent, recognizable brand voice and visual identity across every platform.



This is a hands-on production role, not a supervisory one — you will personally sit in the edit chair for the majority of our video output.



What You'll Do

- Edit long-form YouTube content (tutorials, product explainers, presenter-led videos) from raw footage through to final export, including titling, pacing, and thumbnail-ready framing

- Cut short-form/social content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) for multiple brand accounts, adapting pacing, captions, and format to each platform

- Edit presenter-led sales and funnel videos (e.g. quiz-based sales sequences) to a direct-response standard — clear structure, strong hooks, clean pacing toward a call to action

- Apply and maintain brand style guides (colour, type, lower-thirds, intro/outro, music beds) consistently across our multiple brands, using our established templates and guidelines

- Support trade show and event video content (highlight reels, product demo loops, testimonial cuts)

- Manage footage organization, version control, and a predictable delivery pipeline so stakeholders always know what's in progress and what's ready for review

- Take structured feedback from brand leadership (final creative sign-off sits with the founders) and turn revisions around quickly

- Collaborate with our content calendar/community management process to keep video output aligned with the monthly content plan



What We're Looking For

- 3+ years professional video editing experience, ideally including social-first content and at least some direct-response/marketing video

- Strong working knowledge of at least one professional NLE (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro); CapCut experience is a plus but not required

- A sharp eye for pacing and hook strength — you understand why the first 3 seconds of a Reel matter as much as the first 3 minutes of a YouTube video

- Comfort working across multiple brand identities at once without them bleeding into each other

- Experience turning long presenter recordings into tight, clean cuts without losing the speaker's natural tone

- Comfortable using AI tools in the creative workflow (e.g. AI-assisted transcription, rough-cut generation, upscaling, generative B-roll, or thumbnail/title assistance) to speed up production — but with the judgment to know when a scene needs a human eye and hand instead. We need someone who uses AI to work faster and smarter, not someone who leans on it in place of real editing skill, nor someone who refuses to use it at all

- Strong self-management — this is a remote role with a defined weekly deliverable cadence, not close supervision

- Good written English for coordinating with a distributed team (Philippines, Australia, UK, US)



Bonus: experience with health, wellness, or fitness brand content; motion graphics/basic animation skills; experience cutting trade show or event footage



Please reply with

- A reel or 3–5 links to work you personally edited (please note which pieces were your own cut vs. team output)

- A short note on your NLE experience and any direct-response/social-first video work

- A brief example of how you've used AI tools in a real edit — and, just as important, an example of where you chose not to (or a straight cut/manual edit) because AI wasn't the right call

title: Talented Short-form Video Editor
description:
**Four Role openings | Remote — Philippines | Full-time contractor**



**Salary:** PHP 30,000–50,000 per month

**Payment:** Monthly

**Availability:** Across most of the UK workday, including a daily team stand-up call





## About the Role



We’re looking for four creative, internet-native video editors who know how to turn a script and voiceover into a story people cannot stop watching.



You’ll create polished **3–5-minute, 9:16 videos for Snapchat**, taking ownership of the edit from beginning to end. That means finding the strongest visual assets online, building the story, creating an immediate hook and using pacing, captions, graphics, music and sound design to maintain attention.



This is the role for a talented visual storyteller looking for their next big challenge.



With the support of our Managing Director, you’ll choose a content niche—such as celebrities, sports, hip-hop, crime or influencers—and become our in-house expert on what performs within that space.





## What You’ll Be Doing



* **Create daily Snapchat stories**



  * Edit and deliver one high-quality **3–5-minute vertical video each working day**.

  * Turn a finished script and AI voiceover into a clear, fast-moving visual story.

  * Source strong online assets and combine them with captions, graphics, music, motion and sound design.



* **Own a specialist content niche**



  * Choose and align on a niche with the Managing Director.

  * Learn the important personalities, stories, audiences and formats within that niche.

  * Develop a strong instinct for the hooks, visuals and editing styles that perform best.



* **Keep improving the content**



  * Test new formats, pacing styles, visual treatments and storytelling techniques.

  * Use feedback and performance insights to improve each new video.

  * Help make our editing workflow faster, smarter and more consistent.



* **Work closely with the team**



  * Attend the daily team stand-up call.

  * Remain available and responsive across most of the UK workday.

  * Complete revisions quickly and consistently meet daily deadlines.





## What We’re Looking For



* **Previous short-form video editing experience is required.**

* Strong hands-on experience with both **Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects**.

* A portfolio demonstrating vertical editing, strong pacing and clear visual storytelling.

* A strong understanding of hooks, viewer retention, captions and sound design.

* Good judgement when researching and selecting online visual assets.

* Strong English comprehension, attention to detail and remote communication skills.

* The ability to learn quickly, respond positively to feedback and take ownership of your work.





## What Matters to Us



We don’t care where you went to school, how many years of experience appear on your CV or what you look like.



We care about:



* What you can create.

* How quickly you can learn.

* How well you respond to feedback.

* Whether you can consistently deliver.

* What unique experience, taste and perspective you bring to the team.



You need genuine short-form editing experience, but we care far more about the quality of your work than whether you have been editing for one year or ten.





## How to Apply



 
 with the subject:



**Video Editor Application — [Your Name]**



Include only these four things:



1. Your CV.

2. Links to your strongest videos.

3. A short explanation of why you are the right fit.

4. Your earliest possible start date.



We review and respond to applications daily. Keep an eye on your inbox and spam folder to find out whether you have been selected for the next stage. We will let you know either way.





## Hiring Process



1. Application and portfolio review.

2. A **$20 paid editing task** for selected candidates.

3. Interview.

4. Final job offer.



For the paid task, you’ll receive a shared script and AI voiceover. You’ll need to source the visual assets online and turn them into an engaging **30-second, 9:16 video** that demonstrates your pacing, storytelling and creative style.



Only candidates specifically invited to the paid-task stage should complete the task.

description:
TITLE



Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok Pages (Long-Term Role)



TYPE / SALARY



Full Time · 5–6 days per week · PH or similar time zone $1,000 USD/month starting, potential for performance bonuses. Raises tied to skill and results.



JOB DESCRIPTION



I run TikTok pages that consistently reach millions of views. I'm looking for one editor to take ownership of the editing work alongside me, long term.



Success in this role comes down to two things above all else: editing quality and English comprehension. Because of that, this posting is specific about what the work requires, and the application asks for more than a résumé. I'd rather be clear upfront than have either of us discover a mismatch a month in.



THE WORK



Daily short-form vertical content — talking heads and voiceover/b-roll:



Cutting dead space so videos stay paced and never drag

Stitching the strongest takes into one seamless piece

Adding image overlays on screen to support what's being said

Zooms, crops, and reframes to keep the frame dynamic

B-roll builds: I provide a voiceover and footage, you find the visual that matches each line

Sourcing your own overlay assets — reading the script and independently finding the images it calls for



The last two items are the core of the role. The rest is technical work most editors can learn. Choosing the right visual for the right sentence is what separates a video that reaches 4,000 people from one that reaches 4,000,000.



SOURCING YOUR OWN ASSETS



This is one of the most important parts of the job, and the part most editors are not set up for. I'll give you background and direction, but I want you fully self-sufficient at finding the visuals a script needs. That means:



Reading the script and working out which images the moment actually calls for

Finding high-quality, aesthetically strong photos of the celebrities and influencers being discussed — not the first search result, but the image that looks right on screen

Learning the brands I work with well enough to represent them correctly

Knowing which parts of a brand's website are worth capturing, and pulling clean screenshots of them

Sourcing relevant comments, posts, and screenshots that support the point being made

Placing every asset at the right moment in the video, on the beat the script lands on



I shouldn't have to send you an image folder for a video to get made. You should be able to take the script and go find what it needs.



This requires genuinely understanding English — hearing a sentence and catching the humor, the tone, the reference — because you can't source the right image for a line you don't fully understand. Your English does not need to be perfect. It needs to be strong enough that you follow everything being said and that we can communicate quickly and clearly. Familiarity with internet and pop culture is a significant advantage here, and it's rewarded.



EXAMPLES OF THE WORK



Please watch all three before applying so you know exactly what you'd be producing.



Basic talking head — cutting dead space, piecing clips together, light crops and zooms: 

Talking head with overlays — the same, plus supplied images placed on screen: 

B-roll — a voiceover with footage matched to it line by line. This is where English comprehension shows most: 



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

Strong attention to detail. You catch the frame held a beat too long or the overlay that sits slightly off. This is the most important quality in the role.

Self-sufficiency with assets. You can take a script and go find the images it needs without being handed a folder. This is weighted as heavily as your editing.

Willingness to go the extra step. Reviewing your own export once more and fixing what wasn't flagged.

Strong English comprehension. Understanding is essential; polished speaking and writing is a bonus.

Responsive communication. When I message during working hours, I need a reply promptly rather than the following day.

Exclusivity. This is a full-time position and I'm looking for someone working with me only — no other clients, agencies, or subcontracting. In return you get stability, a real salary, and an employer invested in your growth.

A long-term outlook. I'm hiring someone to grow with these pages over years, not to fill a short-term gap.



This role likely isn't the right fit if you're applying broadly today, prefer briefs explained in detail more than once, or intend to use AI to write your application answers — I'm looking for your own thinking.



REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (TikTok / Reels / Shorts)

CapCut or any software you work quickly in — the output is what matters

Confident sourcing your own images, screenshots, and reference material online, with good taste in what looks right on screen

Reliable internet and a computer that handles daily editing without issues

Available full time, with reasonable overlap with my hours. The volume moves with the content schedule — some weeks run 4–5 days, others run 6–7. I need someone who can flex with it rather than hold to a fixed number of days

Able to receive payment via Wise

Comfortable receiving direct feedback and applying it the first time

PAY AND GROWTH



$1,000 USD/month paid through Wise, with potential for performance bonuses. The ceiling on this role sits well above the starting salary — as you learn the pages and begin contributing your own ideas, your compensation grows accordingly. You'd be working directly with me each day on pages already reaching millions of views.



HOW TO APPLY



Subject line: EDITOR — [number of the example video above you think is hardest to edit] (For example: EDITOR — 2. Applications that don't follow this format won't be reviewed.)



Please include in your message:



Links to 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited, and what you handled on each. If you worked on only part of a video, please say so — accuracy matters more to me than scope.

In your own words, 3–5 sentences, without AI assistance: watch example #3 and describe one editing choice that worked well and one you would have approached differently. There's no right answer — I'm interested in how you evaluate a video.

The software you use and how long you've worked in it.

Your internet speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal) and your typical available hours in PH time.

One sentence on your current work and why you're looking to move.



Paid test — $25 USD. Shortlisted applicants receive a Google Drive folder containing the reference video plus the original voiceover takes and footage. You'll stitch together the strongest takes, match footage to the voiceover, and send back your version. Note that the folder deliberately does not contain every image the script calls for — part of the test is sourcing the missing visuals yourself and placing them where they belong. It should take about an hour. This test is paid $25 USD regardless of the hiring outcome — I don't ask anyone to work unpaid.



Google Drive (reference video and source files): 



A strong test is followed by a short call, and then a start date. I review every application that follows the instructions above.

title: Accounts Receivable & Insurance Collections Specialist

Schedule: Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours



We are hiring an experienced Accounts Receivable & Insurance Collections Specialist to support a growing U.S.-based organization.



The role will focus on billing, sending invoices, monitoring outstanding balances, and consistently following up with insurance companies to ensure payments are received on time.



Strong communication and outbound calling skills are essential. We need someone who is proactive, persistent, organized, and comfortable continuing to follow up until a clear response and payment are received.



This is a long-term, stable opportunity for someone who wants to become a trusted member of the team, grow professionally, and advance based on strong performance and increased responsibilities.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



• Minimum 2 years of hands-on accounts receivable, billing, insurance collections, or payer follow-up experience

• Experience following up with insurance companies or other third-party payers regarding outstanding payments



• Strong outbound calling skills and confidence speaking with U.S.-based insurance representatives



• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills



• Experience monitoring unpaid balances and AR aging



• Strong organization, accuracy, documentation, and follow-through



• Ability to work independently and take ownership of accounts until payment or final resolution



IMPORTANT



This is not a bookkeeping, accounts payable, general virtual assistant, or basic invoice-entry position.



We are not looking for someone who sends an invoice and waits for payment. The right candidate must be comfortable calling insurance companies, asking direct questions, documenting each conversation, and following up consistently until the payment issue is resolved.



This is an outbound-focused AR and collections role. Candidates must be confident, professional, and persistent on the phone.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Follow every assigned account through payment or final resolution



TO APPLY, PLEASE SUBMIT

• Number of years of AR, billing, insurance collections, or payer follow-up experience



• Types of insurance companies or payers you have worked with



• Average number of outbound follow-up or collection calls you handled daily

• One example of a delayed or unpaid account you successfully collected and the steps you took



• A short voice recording introducing yourself, summarizing your relevant experience, and demonstrating how you would speak with an insurance representative about an overdue payment

WORK SETUP

• Philippines-based candidates only



• Must be available during U.S. business hours



• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup internet or power solution, and professional home-office environment required



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



• Starting salary of PHP 40,000 per month



• Opportunities for future salary increases based on performance, professional growth, increased responsibilities, and overall contribution



• Work from home



• Paid training



• Stable, long-term position



• Opportunities for advancement



We are looking for a strong communicator who takes ownership, follows up persistently, and is not afraid to keep calling until a clear response and payment are received.

title: Spanish Phone Support
description:
Remote Bilingual Legal Intake Coordinator (English/Spanish) — Full Time, Long-Term



### About the Role

We are a busy U.S. law firm and we are building a 24/7 client-intake desk. When someone calls

our firm, they are often in a stressful legal situation and they need a calm, professional human

to answer — not a voi
. Your job is to be that human. You will answer calls live, return

missed calls fast, monitor messages and online forms, and make sure no potential client ever

falls through the cracks.



This is a long-term, full-time role with a stable schedule. We pay on time, every time, and we

invest in people who take ownership.



### What You'll Do Every Shift

- Answer incoming calls live through our internet phone system (GoTo softphone)

- Return every missed call with a callback attempt **within 2–5 minutes** — this is the most

important measure of success in this role

- Monitor and respond to voi
s and text messages

- Monitor and respond to online intake form submissions (through Clio)

- Take clear intake information: caller name, phone,
, location, type of legal matter,

urgency, and how they found us

- Enter and update every contact in our intake system so nothing is lost

- Schedule consultations on the firm calendar

- Recognize urgent matters (jail/arrest, court deadline, immigration detention, safety issue)

and escalate them immediately using our written escalation list

- Complete a written shift handoff at the end of every shift



> **Important:** You are NOT giving legal advice. You gather information and connect people to the

> right person on our legal team. We train you on exactly what to say.



### Must-Have Requirements

- **Fully fluent in BOTH English and Spanish** — speaking, listening, reading, and writing.

You will switch between languages on live calls. This is non-negotiable.

- Clear, warm, professional phone voice with a neutral accent in both languages

- Reliable high-speed internet **plus a backup internet source** (mobile hotspot or second

provider) — you cannot go offline mid-shift

- A quiet, dedicated work space with no background noise

- A working computer and a noise-cancelling headset

- Strong attention to detail and great note-taking

- Comfortable using web-based software (we train you on GoTo and Clio)

- Dependable and punctual — shifts start on time, every time

- Able to work the **same fixed schedule long-term** (see Schedule below)



### Nice to Have (Not Required)

- Prior experience in customer service, call center, reception, or virtual assistant work

- Prior experience with a law firm, medical office, or other professional services

- Experience with GoTo, RingCentral, or similar VoIP/softphone systems

- Experience with Clio, Clio Grow, or any CRM/intake software



### Schedule

This role covers 7am to 2:30pm Mountain Time, Monday through Friday (Mountain Time)

You must be able to commit to this schedule consistently. 



### Compensation

- Paid monthly, on time

- Long-term role with raises based on performance

- We are looking for someone to grow with us for years, not weeks





To apply, please do ALL of the following. Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed:



1. Watch this video: 
/shorts/oF4x3PdmJaY?is=EiMrMsBwwwrKiIqf

2. Follow the instructions in the video



We review every complete application personally. Thank you — we're excited to meet you.

title: Performance Video Editor (DTC / Paid Social)
description:
About the role



Monkedia is a fast-growing digital marketing agency, and we're looking for a Performance Video Editor who thinks like a marketer first and an editor second. This is a role for someone who understands consumer psychology and direct response, and who can turn that understanding into short-form video ads that stop the scroll and drive conversion for ecommerce brands.



We care less about polish for its own sake and more about whether you understand why an ad works: how to open on a hook that lands in the first two or three seconds, how to structure that hook both visually and through audio, how to pace a story for a specific brand, platform, and format, and how to hold attention all the way to the CTA. Ideally you've already edited video for DTC ecommerce brands, for organic social and, even better, as paid ads that ran on the Meta platform.

Strong, fast, detail-oriented video editing is the core of the job. AI is how we move faster, not the point of the role. We want you comfortable using AI video and image tools to generate B-roll, fill gaps, and produce variations at speed, without leaning on them as a crutch. The editing instinct and the marketing brain come first; the AI tooling supplements them.



What you'll do

Edit and produce short-form video ads for DTC ecommerce (feed, stories, reels) built to perform, not just to look nice.

Structure hooks that work in the first few seconds, visually and through audio, and pace the whole cut to hold attention to the CTA.



Adapt tone, pacing, and format to each brand and each placement so the ad feels native and on-brand.

Bring a conversion mindset to every cut: you understand the funnel the ad sits in and what it needs to do.

Use AI video and image tools to generate B-roll, fill gaps, and spin up variations quickly, as a supplement to your editing, not a replacement for it.

Clean and shape audio so it sounds natural: voiceover, music, pacing, sync, and sound design.

Add motion graphics, text animation, captions, transitions, and effects that lift retention and clarity.

Produce supporting static creative and variations when a campaign needs them.

Work to brief, manage multiple brands at once, and keep tasks moving in our project-management tools.



Qualifications

Must-have

A marketer's understanding of what makes ads convert: consumer psychology, direct response, hooks, retention, and CTA, not just production skill.

~2+ years editing short-form video for paid social or ecommerce (agency, in-house, or freelance).

A portfolio of DTC / ecommerce video ads. We want to see performance work, ideally ads that ran as paid Meta creative, not only brand reels or logo work.

Strong, fast video editing (Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut, or similar).

A real point of view on hook structure, visual and audio, and on how format changes by platform and placement.

Detail-oriented, organized, responsive, and able to manage multiple brands at pace.

Available during U.S. working hours (EST/CST overlap preferred).

Nice-to-have (strong pluses)

Hands-on with AI video and image generation (Runway, Sora, Kling, Veo, Pika, etc.) for B-roll, variations, and speed, with a sense of which tool fits which job.

Natural-sounding AI audio: voice generation/cloning and sound design that doesn't sound synthetic (ElevenLabs or similar).

Motion-graphics depth, plus strong layout, typography, and visual hierarchy.

Graphic design in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).

Landing-page / web design, and familiarity with Shopify, WordPress, or similar.

Exposure to AI ad-production platforms (e.g. SuperScale) and creative-analytics tools.



Why this role

Own performance video creative for a range of ecommerce brands.

Fast-paced, hands-on, with real ownership of the output and the results it drives.

Use AI to move faster than traditional editors, without losing the marketing craft that makes ads actually convert.
