title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Senior Graphic Designer

Childcare Marketing Group | Remote-First | Full-Time







Position Overview



We are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who can turn strategy into visual impact.

At Childcare Marketing Group, we help childcare centers and early education businesses attract more families, strengthen their brands, and grow. Our creative work is not decoration — it is a critical part of how our clients communicate, compete, and generate results.



As our Senior Graphic Designer, you will take ownership of visual execution across a diverse portfolio of clients. You will work from concept through completion, translating marketing strategies and campaign objectives into creative that is compelling, commercially-minded, and built to perform.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for a brief and follows instructions.

We want a designer who can think, challenge, create, refine, and raise the creative standard. Someone who understands that great design combines creativity with strategy, knows how to work at speed without sacrificing quality, and has the confidence to own projects from beginning to end.



You will work across multiple projects, brands, and formats while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and consistently delivering work that clients are proud to put their name behind.





Compensation



Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and level of expertise.

Performance Bonuses: Additional earning potential may be available based on performance and company programs.





Why You Should Work Here



? Work That Matters: You help transform lives by supporting the marketing of businesses that care for and educate children. Your creative work helps childcare providers connect with more families who need their services.

? Recession-Proof Growth: Childcare is an essential industry, and our clients need effective marketing to continue attracting families, filling places, and growing their businesses.

? Leadership That Has Your Back: You’ll work with a supportive, attentive, and motivated leadership team that wants you to succeed and gives you the support to keep developing.

? An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business and invested in building a high-performing company and team.

? Small-Team Feel: You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas are visible, your work matters, and you’re treated as a person rather than a headcount.

? Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection while staying closely connected to a collaborative international team.

? Top-of-Market Opportunity: We want exceptional people and believe strong talent should have the opportunity to grow with the company.

? Train to Be the Best: Extensive initial and ongoing training, courses, and professional development designed to help you become exceptionally strong at what you do.

? A Workspace That Feels 
 Our remote environment is designed to keep the team connected, collaborative, and engaged even when we're working from different parts of the world.

? Quarterly Town Halls: Regular company-wide updates so you understand what is happening across the business and where we are heading.

? The Dream-On Program: Our CEO grants multiple wishes each year pulled directly from team members' dream boards.

? 25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because great work requires time to recharge and have a life outside work.

? Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days each year to volunteer with a charity of your choice.





What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you will understand our creative standards, clients, workflows, and brand requirements and begin taking full ownership of your design projects.

Ongoing, you will be measured on:

? Creative Quality: Consistently producing polished, original, high-quality creative that meets or exceeds professional agency standards.

? Creative Ownership: Taking projects from initial concept through final delivery with minimal supervision and strong judgment at every stage.

? Brand Consistency: Ensuring every asset reflects the client's brand, audience, positioning, and campaign objectives.

? Strategic Design: Creating visuals that do more than look good — they communicate clearly, support marketing objectives, and contribute to measurable campaign outcomes.

? Speed & Reliability: Managing multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing quality or allowing important details to slip through the cracks.

? Attention to Detail: Catching inconsistencies, errors, spacing issues, formatting problems, and other details before work reaches the client.

? Collaboration: Working effectively with marketers, strategists, copywriters, account managers, and other creative team members to produce stronger work.

? Client Impact: Creating work that clients value, approve confidently, and can use effectively across their marketing.





A Typical Week Might Include



? Reviewing creative briefs and marketing objectives before translating them into visual concepts.

? Developing concepts, layouts, graphics, advertisements, social media creative, presentations, and other marketing assets.

? Taking a project from rough concept through design, revision, approval, and final delivery.

? Collaborating with Account Managers, Marketing Strategists, copywriters, and other internal specialists.

? Reviewing existing client creative and identifying opportunities to improve visual consistency and effectiveness.

? Managing multiple projects simultaneously while prioritizing deadlines and maintaining quality.

? Presenting creative concepts and explaining the strategic thinking behind your design decisions.

? Responding to feedback, refining creative, and knowing when to push an idea further versus when to move forward.

? Staying current with design trends, creative technology, AI tools, and evolving visual communication practices.





Key Competencies



? Creative Thinker: You generate original ideas rather than simply replicating what already exists.

? Exceptional Attention to Detail: You notice the small things that separate good design from outstanding design.

? Strategic Designer: You understand that design needs to serve an audience, communicate a message, and support a business objective.

? High Standards: You hold your own work to a professional standard and are not satisfied with "good enough."

? Excellent Communicator: You can explain creative decisions clearly and confidently to both internal teammates and professional clients.

? Problem Solver: You can work through unclear briefs, creative challenges, competing priorities, and tight deadlines without becoming stuck.

? Adaptable: You can move between different brands, industries, audiences, and creative requirements without losing quality.

? Time Management Master: You know how to manage your workload, prioritize competing deadlines, and deliver consistently.

? Collaborative: You know when to lead creatively, when to listen, and how to make the people around you better.

? Resilient & Self-Confident: You are comfortable receiving feedback, defending a strong creative idea when appropriate, and continually improving your work.





This Role Is Not for You If



? You need someone to give you exact instructions for every design decision.

? You are primarily interested in making things look attractive without considering the marketing objective behind them.

? You struggle to manage multiple projects or deadlines simultaneously.

? You take creative feedback personally or resist revisions.

? You regularly miss small details that affect the quality of finished work.

? You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving agency environment where priorities can change.

? You need constant supervision to stay productive.

? You are not interested in continuing to develop your creative skills and staying current with new design tools and trends.









Skills and Experience Required



? 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong track record of producing commercial, marketing-focused creative in an agency, in-house marketing, advertising, or similarly fast-paced environment. 

? A strong portfolio demonstrating high-level commercial and marketing design work across multiple formats and industries.

? Thorough understanding of graphic design principles, including typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, colour, visual storytelling, and brand consistency.

? Demonstrated ability to take a project from concept through final execution.

? Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

? Strong understanding of designing for digital marketing, including social media, paid advertising, web,
, and other digital channels.

? Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

? Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

? Strong attention to detail and quality control.

? A reliable remote work setup and ability to work independently.





Preferred Skills and Experience



? Previous experience working in a digital marketing or creative agency.

? Experience designing creative specifically for paid advertising and conversion-focused campaigns.

? Experience working across multiple client brands simultaneously.

? Experience with motion graphics, video editing, animation, or other multimedia design.

? Experience with Figma, Canva, or similar collaborative design platforms.

? Familiarity with AI-assisted creative and design tools.

? Experience designing for childcare, education, franchise, healthcare, or other multi-location businesses.

? Experience presenting creative concepts to clients or senior stakeholders.

? Understanding of marketing performance and how creativity can influence engagement, conversion, and acquisition.





Work Environment 

This is a full-time, remote-first position.





About Childcare Marketing Group 

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow with smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

title: Operations Executive
description:
Creator Operations Coordinator (Full-Time, Remote)



Company: Cult Media (UGC / creator marketing agency for apps) Type: Full-time, remote Pay: $1,400 to $1,800/month depending on experience (open to discussion for the right person) Start: ASAP



About Us



We run creator armies for apps, from bootstrapped founders to post-IPO companies. We recruit and manage hundreds of UGC creators across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube on behalf of our clients, get them warmed up, and get them posting branded content that drives real growth. We're a small, fast-moving team and we're rebuilding our operations function right now, so this is a chance to help shape how things run rather than just fitting into an existing machine.



The Role



We need a second operations person to work alongside our current VA and take real ownership of the creator side of the business: making sure creators actually post, staying on top of account warm-up, keeping our trackers accurate, and being the fast, reliable point of contact creators go to instead of getting lost in 
 DMs.



This is not a creative or strategy role. We need someone who is organized, chronically online, comfortable chasing people persistently but politely, and who treats a spreadsheet or tracker like it's sacred. If "who hasn't posted yet, who's still warming up, and why" is a question you'd naturally want to answer before anyone asks it, this is your job.



What You'll Own



Creator communication and follow-up: DM and follow up with creators on 
 and other channels to make sure they've set up accounts, are warming up on schedule, and are posting on time. Chase people down without being annoying about it.



Account health and warm-up tracking: Track every creator's account status (day of warm-up, when they're cleared for branded content, any account health flags) and keep our tracker current and accurate, not just "roughly right."



Campaign staffing visibility: Keep an up-to-date view of how many creators are active vs. needed per campaign, flag understaffed campaigns early, and help source and onboard replacements.



Creator support: Be the first line of response for common creator questions (payment issues, shadowbans, which username to use, how CPM works, etc.), using an FAQ/SOP we're building out, and escalate anything unusual.



CRM and creator ranking upkeep: Help maintain our internal creator database, ratings, and notes so we always know who our best, most reliable creators are.




 management: Post new brand deal opportunities, keep channels organized, review applicants against basic criteria, and generally keep the community easy to navigate for creators.



Reporting: Send a short, honest daily or end-of-day update on active creators, posting status, and any blockers, no vague "everything's on track" updates. We want real numbers.



What We Don't Need You To Do



Write creative briefs or content strategy (that stays in-house with leadership)

Manage client relationships or client calls

Make payment approvals or have financial admin access



You Might Be a Fit If



You've done creator/influencer management, community management, or UGC campaign coordination before (agency-side experience is a big plus)



You're comfortable in 
, Sideshift/LaunchPoint-style creator platforms, Slack, and 
 or similar tools (or you pick up new tools fast)



You're detail-oriented to the point of being a little relentless about it, things don't fall through the cracks on your watch



You communicate clearly and quickly in writing, and you're online and responsive during US afternoon/evening hours (creators are most active around 5pm EST)



You can work independently, flag problems early, and don't sit on bad news hoping it resolves itself



Nice to Have



Familiarity with TikTok/Instagram creator or affiliate ecosystems

Experience with CPM-based or performance-based creator deals

Basic comfort using AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude) to speed up repetitive work like drafting FAQ answers or summarizing creator threads

How to Apply



Send us:



A short intro on your relevant experience (creator management, community management, ops, etc.)

Any tools/platforms you've used for creator or campaign management



If selected, we will requeste a 2-min Loom intro.

title: Social Media Content Manager & Video Editor- Caribbean Relocation Brand
description:
About the Brand



Next Haven Life is a growing Caribbean relocation intelligence platform for people comparing where to build their next haven.



We serve veterans, retirees, remote professionals, internationally minded families, members of the Caribbean diaspora, and people seeking greater geographic independence.



Our content is practical and realistic. We do not sell a fantasy version of Caribbean living. We discuss cost of living, residency, healthcare, housing, infrastructure, family needs, travel access, risk, and the tradeoffs involved in relocating.



The founder will primarily record direct-to-camera, talking-head videos. Your job will be to turn that raw footage into polished long-form videos and a consistent stream of short-form social content.



Role Overview



I am looking for a dependable Social Media Content Manager and Video Editor who can manage the post-production and distribution side of the Next Haven Life content system.



You should be comfortable taking raw talking-head footage, editing it into engaging YouTube videos, extracting strong short-form clips, creating thumbnails and graphics, writing platform-specific captions, and scheduling approved content.



This is not just a basic video-cutting position. I need someone who understands pacing, audience retention, storytelling, content repurposing, and maintaining a consistent brand across platforms.



You will not be expected to provide immigration, legal, tax, real estate, or financial advice. Scripts and factual claims will either be provided or approved before publication.



Primary Responsibilities

Video Editing



-Edit long-form talking-head YouTube videos.

-Remove pauses, mistakes, repetitions, and unnecessary sections.

-Improve pacing without making the speaker sound unnatural.

-Add tasteful zooms, transitions, lower thirds, captions, screenshots, maps, charts, B-roll, and supporting visuals.

-Clean and balance audio.

-Apply basic color correction.

-Add branded introductions, outros, disclaimers, and calls to action.

-Export videos in the correct format for each platform.



Short-Form Content



-Identify the strongest 
nts from each long-form video.

-Create YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and
 Reels.

-Add accurate burned-in captions.

-Write strong opening hooks.

-Reframe footage appropriately for vertical viewing.

-Keep short-form edits direct, clear, and professional rather than overly flashy.



YouTube Management



-Create compelling but honest titles.

-Write video descriptions and chapters.

-Create or coordinate thumbnails.

-Upload and schedule approved videos.

-Add cards, end screens, playlists, links, disclaimers, and calls to action.

-Monitor basic performance data such as click-through rate, audience retention, watch time, and subscriber growth.

-Recommend improvements based on actual performance.

-Social Media Management



Repurpose approved content for:



-YouTube

-Instagram



-LinkedIn



Responsibilities include:



-Writing platform-specific captions.

-Scheduling posts.

-Creating carousels, quote graphics, and supporting visuals.

-Maintaining a consistent content calendar.

-Responding to routine comments using approved guidance.

-Escalating questions involving legal, tax, immigration, property, healthcare, or individualized relocation advice.

-Keeping content files and publishing records organized.

-Expected Monthly Output



The initial target will be approximately:



-2–4 edited long-form YouTube videos

-8–16 short-form videos

-2 thumbnail options for each long-form video

-Platform-specific captions and descriptions

-YouTube chapters, cards, end screens, and links

-Supporting graphics or carousels when appropriate

-Content scheduling across approved platforms

-One simple monthly analytics report

-An organized archive of raw footage, project files, thumbnails, captions, and final exports



The workload may grow as the brand develops.



Brand Style

Next Haven Life should feel:



Credible

-Strategic

-Calm

-Direct

-Experienced

-Family-conscious

-Caribbean-informed

-Professional without feeling corporate

-Realistic rather than promotional



The content may include a warm Caribbean influence, but it should never feel like a tourism commercial.



Avoid excessive sound effects, distracting transitions, 
-style edits, exaggerated thumbnails, misleading titles, and clickbait that weakens trust.



The ideal visual style is clean, polished, authoritative, warm, and modern.



Required Skills

You should have demonstrated experience with:



-Talking-head YouTube editing

-Short-form vertical video editing

-Audio cleanup and synchronization

-Captions and motion graphics

-YouTube thumbnails

-Social media scheduling

-Content repurposing

-Canva

-YouTube Studio

-File and project organization

-Strong written English

-Following a defined brand voice

-Meeting deadlines without constant supervision



You may use Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or another professional editing platform, provided you can deliver consistent, high-quality work.



Strongly Preferred

Experience with any of the following is helpful:



-YouTube audience-retention editing

-Educational or professional content

-Personal brands

-Caribbean, expatriate, financial, veteran, retirement, travel, or relocation topics

-LinkedIn content

-Canva brand kits

-Microsoft 365 or OneDrive

-Airtable

-AI-assisted editing and content repurposing

-Basic analytics and A/B thumbnail testing



Responsible use of AI is welcome, but all captions, titles, summaries, and factual statements must be reviewed before submission.



Work Arrangement

This is a remote position.



Most work can be completed asynchronously. However, you should be available for a short weekly planning or review call and have at least limited overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



Clear communication is essential. I value people who raise questions early, provide honest progress updates, and do not disappear when a deadline approaches.



Paid Trial Project

Selected applicants will be offered a paid trial assignment using one talking-head video.



The trial may include:



-Editing one long-form video segment

-Creating two or three short-form clips

-Producing one YouTube thumbnail

-Drafting a title, description, and social caption

-Organizing and submitting the source and final files correctly



The trial will be used to evaluate editing quality, judgment, reliability, communication, and ability to follow the Next Haven Life style.



Do not complete unpaid sample work before being selected for the paid trial.



How to Apply

Please include the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining why this role fits your experience.

2. Links to two or three talking-head videos you personally edited.

3. Links to at least two short-form videos you created.

4. One example of a YouTube thumbnail you designed.

5. The editing software you use.

6. Your current availability and preferred work schedule.

7. Your requested monthly salary for 15–20 hours per week.

8. A description of your process for turning one long-form video into multiple social posts.

9. A short explanation of how you use AI in your editing or content workflow.

10. Confirmation that you are willing to complete a paid trial project.



Begin your application subject line with:



NEXT HAVEN EDITOR — [Your Name]



Applications that do not use this subject line will not be considered.



Please do not send a generic application. I am looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and helping develop a credible Caribbean relocation media brand.

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

title: SEO + GEO / AI Search Visibility Specialist
description:
SEO + GEO / AI Search Visibility Specialist



Google • ChatGPT • Claude • Perplexity



We are looking for an experienced SEO and GEO/AEO specialist to solve a very specific visibility problem for Revela Retreats, based in Costa Rica.



Our target market is the USA



Although our retreat centre is in Costa Rica, our primary target market is the United States.



We want Americans researching subjects related to iboga, ibogaine, addiction recovery, PTSD, mental health, detox, integration, psychedelic-assisted therapy and professional education to be able to discover us.



Our problem



Competitors in Costa Rica and Mexico are appearing prominently when Americans search online for terms such as:



- Ibogaine Costa Rica

- Iboga Costa Rica

- Iboga retreat Costa Rica

- Ibogaine retreat

- Ibogaine treatment

- Ibogaine and addiction

- Ibogaine and opioid addiction

- Ibogaine and PTSD

- Psychedelic-assisted therapy

- Psychedelic education for mental health professionals



These competitors are openly using these keywords and being found.



We are not visible enough and, as a result, we are not attracting the clients we should be attracting.



We need someone who can determine WHY our competitors are being found and Revela is not — and then help us fix it.



Our objective



We want Revela to become discoverable to our US target audience through:



Google • ChatGPT • Claude • Perplexity • other AI/search platforms



We are particularly interested in building authority around Costa Rica + iboga + ibogaine + addiction recovery + PTSD + mental health professional education + retreats and integration.



Skills we are looking for



You should have genuine experience with:



- Technical SEO

- US-focused SEO and keyword research

- Google Search Console

- Competitor and keyword-gap analysis

- Search intent

- On-page SEO

- Content strategy and topic clusters

- Internal linking

- Backlink building and digital PR

- Schema / structured data

- Entity SEO

- Local and international SEO

- GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)

- AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)

- AI / LLM search visibility

- Google indexing, crawling, sitemaps and canonical URLs

- Measuring rankings, impressions, conversions and organic traffic



This is NOT simply a social-media, VA or blog-writing position.



We need someone who understands how to build search authority and visibility in the US market and who is comfortable working with the terminology and subject matter above.



IMPORTANT — please do this before applying



Search Google as though you were an American looking for these services:



“ibogaine Costa Rica”

“iboga Costa Rica”

“iboga retreat Costa Rica”

“ibogaine treatment Costa Rica”



Look at the businesses that appear.



Then analyse:







Please answer these questions in your application:



1. Why do you believe our competitors are being found and Revela is not?



2. What are the first 5–10 things you would investigate or change?



3. How would you specifically improve our visibility to people searching from the United States?

5. Please provide examples of SEO results you have achieved, preferably with measurable before-and-after results.



We are a growing Costa Rican retreat business looking for someone who can potentially work with us long term.



If you understand this problem, have the skills to solve it, are comfortable working with these keywords and believe you can significantly improve our visibility in the United States, we want to hear from you.

The Role

You'll start by supporting our CMO with daily marketing operations, and as you prove yourself, you'll grow into a Marketing Operative who owns your own initiatives, pipelines, and results. If you're organized, reliable, detail-oriented, and looking to build a longterm marketing career with a fast-growing company, this role is designed for you.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend / AI Pipelines) — AI Start Up
description:
We build agents for humans. EchoVerse Collective is an AI-native media, content and intelligence company. Our flagship product is Dispatches — a personalised daily brief about AI, written by four AI columnists and approved by a named human editor before anything ships. You can read it at 
/dispatches. Behind it is an agentic pipeline that researches, writes, verifies, narrates and delivers every article, adapted to each reader. Dispatches is the flagship, not the whole company: alongside it we build document-automation systems — invoice and back-office processing with human review — and other backend-heavy intelligence products. These are live products with real users, not prototypes.



We build differently. AI agents — Claude Code, Codex — are our primary instruments. We plan in written specs, fan work out to parallel agents, and review everything that ships. One engineer here has the leverage of a small team. We are hiring the second one.



THE WORK



You will be engineer #2, working directly with the lead developer and owning real workstreams end to end — from written spec to deployed, tested, monitored production code. The work is backend-first: most of your time will be in the agentic pipeline and the data layer, with full-stack work on top when a workstream reaches the surface. In a given month you might:



- Extend a Python agentic worker (FastAPI + LangGraph): pipeline stages, structured output with strict validation, verification and evidence systems, run lifecycles, cost tracking, schedulers and durable queues.

- Work the data layer: Postgres (Supabase) with row-level security — schema design, migrations, pgvector and embeddings — plus Stripe billing and webhook plumbing.

- Build document-processing flows: OCR and extraction, trust scoring, exception routing, human review surfaces.

- Build and harden features across a Next.js / React / TypeScript reader app and ops console.

- Write the tests (pytest, Vitest, Playwright), run the QA pass, and ship.



You will not be a ticket-taker. You get context-rich written specs, wide latitude in how you execute, and direct review of your work by the lead — the same bar we hold our own code to.



YOU WILL FIT IF



- You have five or more years building production software, with senior backend skills in Python and/or TypeScript — both is ideal. Typed, tested code with validation at the boundaries is a habit, not a request.

- You have real database depth. You design Postgres schemas, write migrations confidently, and understand auth and row-level-security models — not just an ORM user.

- You use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar — as a core part of how you work, and you can explain the workflow: how you spec tasks for an agent, how you review its output, when you take over by hand, and a time it burned you. This is the most important requirement in this ad and we will test it in depth.

- You have built with LLM APIs beyond a chat wrapper: structured output, retries and fallbacks, prompt iteration, some form of eval or regression checking, cost awareness. Multi-stage pipelines or agent frameworks are a big plus.

- You have enough full-stack range to work competently in a modern React/Next.js codebase and a CI/deploy pipeline. Backend is the centre of this role, but nothing here is "not my job".

- You work well async from written specs, you say plainly what is done versus in-progress versus not started, and you never report a result you did not verify.

- You write excellent English. Most of our communication is written.



Tell us if you have any of these: LangGraph or similar pipeline frameworks; batch APIs, prompt caching and other LLM cost engineering; Supabase specifically (RLS, auth, storage); Stripe; pgvector and search tuning; eval harnesses; job schedulers and durable queues (APScheduler, Celery, Temporal); audio or video generation pipelines; Playwright or API work against poorly documented services; front-end craft.



YOU WILL NOT FIT IF



- You need a ticket queue and a detailed brief before you can start.

- Your LLM experience is a chat wrapper.

- You treat AI coding tools as autocomplete, or you ship their output unread.

- You report progress by effort rather than by verified results.



DETAILS



- PHP 150,000–220,000 per month, depending on experience. We pay at the top of the market for the right person.

- Full-time, fully remote, Philippines.

- Independent contractor, monthly invoicing, 13th-month bonus.

- We are in London (GMT+1). We need three hours of overlap — your afternoon covers it. The rest of your hours are flexible.

- We pay by Wise, Payoneer or direct transfer, whichever suits you.

- You bring a reliable machine and connection; we cover AI tooling subscriptions and API costs.



HOW TO APPLY — two things, both required



1. The most complex backend or LLM-powered system you have built — a multi-stage pipeline, a data-heavy service, an automation with real failure handling. A short paragraph: what it did, the hardest problem in it, and a link (repo, write-up or demo) if you can share one.



2. Your AI-assisted development workflow — which tools, how you structure tasks for agents, how you review their output, and one concrete example of a task you shipped this way. Keep it short at this stage. A few hundred words is plenty.



Applications missing either will not be read.



SUBJECT LINE



Dispatches build — [name]



where [name] is the columnist who covers the technical desk. It is on the site. The wrong subject line is filtered automatically.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



From everyone who applies we shortlist five to eight people. Those people get a short async technical task, scoped to a few hours.



We pay PHP 2,000 for that task. Everyone who reaches that round is paid, on delivery, whether or not we hire you. It is not a competition prize and it is not conditional on us liking what you built. If we asked you for it, you are paid for it.



From there, two or three people do a live pairing session — you work a real problem with your AI tooling of choice, and we watch how you drive it. One person gets the job. The whole process takes under two weeks.

title: YouTube Video Editor – Long-Form + Motion Graphics
description:
I'm looking for a creative video editor to work with me on an ongoing basis editing long-form YouTube videos for my channel.



The videos are mainly tutorial / talking-head style, usually combining talking-head footage with screen recordings, B-roll, text, graphics, motion graphics, sound effects and other visual elements to keep the video engaging.



I'm not looking for a beginner. You should already be comfortable editing YouTube videos and be able to show examples of your previous work.



I have a specific editing style I'm developing for the channel, and I'm happy to provide examples, feedback and direction. I'm looking for someone who has a good foundation, good visual instincts and, importantly, is able to learn and improve quickly.



However, your knowledge and use of your preferred video editing tool must be advanced.



The goal is to develop a long-term working relationship where you become familiar with the channel, the editing style and what I'm looking for, rather than working with a different editor for every video.



THE EDITING



The raw material will mainly consist of:



* Talking-head footage

* Screen recordings / tutorials

* B-roll

* Graphics and images



The finished videos should feel polished, modern and visually interesting, as well as maintain rythm and engagement.



I'm looking for someone who understands how to make talking-head content more engaging through things such as:



* Good pacing and cuts

* Motion graphics

* Animated text and typography

* Zooms and visual emphasis

* Screen-recording animations

* Sound effects and sound design

* Creative transitions where appropriate

* Other visual ideas that help explain what is being discussed



I don't want excessive effects added just for the sake of it. The editing should support the content and help maintain viewer attention.



WORKLOAD



I expect approximately 2 long-form videos per month, although the amount of work may vary from month to month.



A typical video may involve approximately four or five days of editing, depending on its length and complexity.



This is therefore better suited to someone interested in an ongoing flexible collaboration rather than a fixed number of hours every week.



PAYMENT



I would prefer to pay per finished minute of edited video rather than per hour.



For example, if the final edited video is 20 minutes long, payment would be based on 20 finished minutes.



The exact rate can be agreed depending on your experience, portfolio and the level of editing required.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should:



* Already have experience editing YouTube or similar online video content

* Be able to show examples of your previous editing work

* Have good visual and creative instincts

* Have some experience with motion graphics

* Be comfortable receiving detailed feedback

* Be able to reproduce a style from reference videos

* Be willing to learn and improve over time

* Communicate reliably

* Be interested in developing a long-term working relationship



I'm more interested in finding someone with good fundamentals, creativity and the ability to learn than someone with an impressive job title.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send me:



1. 2–3 examples of your best relevant editing work, preferably long-form YouTube, tutorial or talking-head videos.

title: Procurement Specialist (experience with US and Asian suppliers required)
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a U.S.-based manufacturer and eCommerce company specializing in high-performance adhesives and industrial products. We serve customers through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B distribution channels across multiple global markets.



We are looking for a Procurement Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building supplier relationships, negotiating favorable commercial terms, solving supply chain challenges, and continuously improving procurement operations. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, proactive, highly organized, and comfortable working with suppliers across multiple countries and cultures.







Position Summary

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing and managing suppliers across the United States and Asia, negotiating pricing and commercial terms, evaluating supplier capabilities, and ensuring a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials.



This role plays a critical part in protecting supply continuity, reducing procurement costs, supporting contract manufacturing initiatives, and ensuring Starbond maintains a diversified supplier network that supports long-term business growth.



Key Responsibilities



Strategic Sourcing

Source, evaluate, and qualify suppliers across the United States and Asia.

Conduct supplier research, RFQs, quotation comparisons, and supplier evaluations.

Develop and maintain qualified primary and backup suppliers for critical materials.

Identify new sourcing opportunities that improve cost, quality, and supply continuity.

Support contract manufacturer and third-party logistics (3PL) sourcing initiatives.

Verify supplier capabilities, certifications, and compliance requirements.



Supplier Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers.

Monitor supplier responsiveness, lead times, pricing, and overall performance.

Conduct supplier performance reviews and maintain supplier scorecards.

Coordinate corrective actions when supplier performance issues arise.

Work closely with suppliers to resolve procurement challenges and minimize operational disruptions.



Cost Optimization

Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements.

Analyze supplier quotations and landed costs.

Benchmark supplier pricing and market conditions.

Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and supply reliability.

Recommend sourcing strategies that improve overall profitability.



Procurement Operations

Maintain accurate supplier records and procurement databases.

Support purchase order creation and supplier follow-ups.

Keep supplier pricing, lead times, MOQs, and procurement data up to date.

Organize procurement documentation and sourcing records.

Ensure procurement information is accurate, complete, and audit-ready.



Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Prepare procurement reports and sourcing updates.

Maintain procurement dashboards and tracking tools.

Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes and documentation.

Support continuous improvement initiatives across procurement and supply chain operations.

Proactively identify supply risks and recommend mitigation strategies.





Qualifications



Required

Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain.

Hands-on experience working with both U.S. and Asian suppliers (China, Taiwan, Vietnam, India, or other APAC countries).

Proven experience sourcing, qualifying, and negotiating with international suppliers.

Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.

Excellent analytical and cost analysis abilities.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.



Preferred

Experience working with contract manufacturers or OEM/ODM suppliers.

Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial products, chemicals, or eCommerce businesses.

Familiarity with ERP, MRP, or procurement management systems.

Experience analyzing supplier performance metrics and procurement KPIs.





What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who:

Takes ownership and follows through without constant supervision.

Builds strong supplier relationships while negotiating effectively.

Thinks strategically and solves problems proactively.

Communicates clearly and escalates risks early.

Makes data-driven decisions rather than assumptions.

Continuously looks for opportunities to improve procurement processes.

Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

Can comfortably work with suppliers across different countries, cultures, and time zones.

title: Outbound Appointment Setter / Business Development Representative
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly professional, confident, and results-driven Outbound Appointment Setter / Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team.



You will represent several of our business brands, including Business Health Matters, MarketWell Solutions, 10XCoach.ai, and other affiliated companies and programmes.



Your primary responsibility is simple but extremely important:



Make outbound calls, engage decision-makers, create interest, and schedule qualified demos, meetings, and appointments for our sales and leadership teams.



This is not a passive virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, speaking with business owners and executives, overcoming objections, following up consistently, and asking prospects to schedule the next meeting.



Excellent English Is an Absolute Requirement



Mastery of the English language is a MUST.



You must have excellent spoken and written English, as you will be speaking directly with U.S.-based business owners, executives, professionals, and prospective clients.



Excellent spoken and written English

Clear, professional pronunciation

Strong conversational skills

Excellent listening and comprehension skills

Confidence communicating with business owners and executives

The ability to think and respond naturally rather than simply reading a script

Professional telephone etiquette

Strong grammar and vocabulary



If you are uncomfortable speaking English on the telephone for several hours per day, this position is not a good fit.



Primary Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



Make outbound calls to prospective customers and business contacts

Introduce our companies, services, programs, and solutions

Communicate professionally with business owners, executives, managers, and other decision-makers

Identify the appropriate decision-maker within an organization

Generate interest and qualify prospective opportunities

Schedule demos, discovery calls, meetings, consultations, and appointments

Follow approved call scripts while maintaining a natural conversation

Handle common questions and initial objections professionally

Conduct consistent follow-up with prospects who are not immediately ready to schedule

Document calls, conversations, outcomes, and follow-up requirements

Update prospect status and pipeline stages

Manage scheduled follow-up activities

Coordinate appointments with our sales and leadership teams

Meet daily and weekly outbound activity expectations

Meet appointment-setting and performance goals

Participate in training, coaching, and performance reviews

Learn the value propositions of multiple brands and confidently communicate the appropriate message for each

Companies & Programs You May Represent



You may conduct outreach on behalf of multiple organizations and programs, including:



Business Health Matters

Business health assessments, consulting, business growth, organizational improvement, and strategic business solutions.



MarketWell Solutions

Marketing, business development, growth strategies, customer acquisition, and related business solutions.



10XCoach.ai

An AI-powered coaching and business education platform designed to help entrepreneurs and business leaders improve performance, accelerate growth, and build stronger businesses.



Additional Brands & Programs

As our organization grows, you may be trained to conduct outbound campaigns for additional affiliated companies, clients, products, partnerships, and programs.



Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



Confident on the telephone

Professional and articulate

Energetic and self-motivated

Persistent without being aggressive

Comfortable speaking with executives and business owners

Able to build rapport quickly

Comfortable hearing "no" and continuing to the next opportunity

Highly organized

Dependable and accountable

Comfortable working with technology and CRM systems

Able to follow a structured sales process

Coachable and willing to improve

Goal-oriented and motivated by measurable results

Preferred Experience



Previous experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:



Appointment setting

Outbound calling

B2B telemarketing

Business development

Lead generation

Inside sales

SDR/BDR positions

Cold calling

Customer acquisition

CRM management

U.S.-based customer or client communication



B2B outbound calling experience is strongly preferred.



Experience speaking with U.S. business owners, executives, and decision-makers is a major advantage.



Technology Requirements



You should have:



Reliable high-speed internet

Reliable computer

High-quality professional headset

Quiet and professional home working environment

Backup internet/power solution strongly preferred

Ability to learn and work effectively within our in-house CRM and calling systems

Performance Expectations



This is a results-oriented position.



Your performance may be measured using KPIs such as:



Outbound calls completed

Decision-maker conversations

Qualified conversations

Follow-up activities

Appointments scheduled

Demos scheduled

Appointment show rate

Qualified opportunities generated

CRM accuracy and completeness



We value quality conversations and qualified appointments, not simply high call volume.



Work Schedule



Because you will primarily communicate with businesses and prospects in the United States, you must be comfortable working hours that overlap with U.S. business hours, typically times within 8:00 AM- 6:00 PM EST.



During the interview process, we will discuss specific working hours and schedule expectations.

Opportunities to work across multiple businesses and campaigns

Opportunities for increased responsibility based on performance

How to Apply — Please Follow These Instructions Carefully

title: Co-Host / Operations Manager — Guest Experience & Team Lead
description:
The Problem We Need Solved



We run a growing short-term rental business — 18+ units across the East Coast in the United States — and for our guests, the experience begins the 
nt they hit "send" on their very first message. But we've outgrown our current setup:



- Messages need to be answered fast, warmly, and like a real human — not a copy-paste script.

- When something goes sideways, someone has to stay calm and make it right before it becomes a bad review.

- Our small VA team is talented but needs a leader to keep everyone rowing in the same direction.

- Our systems and SOPs need an owner who improves them — not just someone who follows them.



That's where you come in. We're not looking for a "virtual assistant." We're looking for a right-hand operator — a Co-Host who treats our guests like their own and our business like they've got skin in the game.



Your Mission



Be the voice our guests trust and the operator who keeps everything running behind the scenes. You are the first person a guest hears from — and the last line of defense before a small hiccup turns into a one-star surprise.



You'll…



- Own the full guest journey — inquiry, booking, check-in, mid-stay, and checkout — with fast, warm, genuinely human communication.

- Jump on a call when a message won't cut it, and resolve issues calmly in real time.

- Turn frustrated guests into 5-star reviews through sincere, thoughtful recovery.

- Coordinate cleaners, maintenance, and property teams so every turnover is guest-ready.

- Lead, train, and hold accountable a small team of VAs.

- Build and refine the SOPs that make our operation faster and tighter as we scale.

- Spot bottlenecks and bring us ideas on pricing, scheduling, and workflow.

- Handle light social media and admin as needed.



Real Talk — The Heart of This Job



Let's be upfront about what this role actually is: you'll be on the phone with upset guests often. A booking went sideways, the check-in code won't work, the unit isn't what they pictured — and you're the calm, confident voice on the other end. If phone calls with frustrated people wear you down, this isn't the role for you. If you thrive on turning tension into gratitude and finding a fix nobody else spotted, keep reading.



To do this well, you'll need:



- A neutral, no-accent English speaking voice. Guests should never have to strain to understand you. This one is non-negotiable.

- Real de-escalation instincts. You can take someone from furious to thankful in a single conversation, without ever losing your cool.

- Creative problem-solving under pressure. When there's no obvious answer, you invent one — fast, and on your feet.



This Role Is Perfect for Someone Who…



- Can turn an upset guest saying "the AC won't turn on" into a guest who still leaves five stars.

- Reads the emotion behind a message and knows exactly when to type and when to pick up the phone.

- Gets a little rush from closing out a tense situation with one calm, kind reply.

- Treats a clean inbox and a fully-confirmed turnover calendar as a personal win.

- Leads a team the way they'd want to be led — clear, kind, and accountable.

- Constantly asks, "What else can I solve here before anyone even has to ask?"



What You Bring



- Hands-on short-term rental experience (Airbnb, VRBO, 
, or similar).

- Excellent written and spoken English with a truly neutral, no-accent speaking voice — this is non-negotiable, because you'll be on live calls with guests daily.

- Genuine phone confidence. You'll be making and taking calls with upset guests every day, and staying calm under fire is the job — not the exception.

- Proven de-escalation and creative problem-solving. You can turn furious into grateful, and improvise a fix when there's no playbook for the situation in front of you.

- Leadership experience running a small (virtual) team and keeping people accountable.

- Tech-savvy across hospitality platforms — PMS/messaging tools, calendars, Slack, WhatsApp, 
, Hospitable, and the like.

- High EQ, real warmth, and a genuine passion for hospitality.



Your Setup



- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, a second monitor, and a noise-canceling headset.

- Available for daytime coverage in our market's time zone (US East)— guest issues don't keep office hours.



Compensation & Growth



- Competitive monthly salary (based on experience) plus performance bonuses tied to review scores and guest satisfaction.

- This is a long-term seat with a real path into Operations Lead / Regional roles as we grow. You won't just run the standards — you'll help shape them.



How We Hire



We don't hire off a resume — we hire off mindset.



How do you take feedback? We love people who grow from clear, kind communication.

How do you make decisions? You'll act independently, but always with care.

What's your default mode? Our favorite people ask, "What else can I own here?"



To Apply



Please send both (applications missing either won't be considered):

- Your resume/CV.

- A 1–2 minute English introduction video or voice sample introducing yourself and telling us why this role is the one for you.



NOTE: must be available US EST Day Time and looking for 7 days a week of coverage.

title: Marketing and Social Media Manager — Boutique Resort (Paid Ads, Content, AI)
description:
Are you a marketing rockstar who wants to build a brand from the ground up? Then we want YOU!



ABOUT US

We're a US-based hospitality group taking over a struggling boutique treehouse resort in New England and creating a beautiful & unique resort. Our founder has 8+ years running an award-winning vacation rental. You'd be a founding member of a small, focused team.



THE ROLE

Build and run our digital marketing from scratch — social media, paid ads,
, influencer partnerships, website, and OTA optimization. You'll also supervise AI agents that handle guest communications. This is a builder role, not a maintainer role.



RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Social Media: Daily content creation for the resort's Instagram/Facebook/Tik-Toks plus the founder's "building in public" Instagram/YouTube accounts. Monitor DMs and comments daily, move interested followers toward bookings.



2. Paid Advertising: Build, test, and improve Meta and Google ad campaigns. Track cost per lead, cost per booking, and return on ad spend. Grow what's working, stop what's not.



3. Website & Landing Pages: Keep the booking website up to date. Build landing pages for each campaign. Update seasonal photos and content every few months.



4.
 & SMS: Build 5 automated flows (Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Pre-Stay, In-Stay/Review, Rebooking) plus monthly campaign
s. Grow the list via website, social, and Wi-Fi capture.



5. Campaign Planning: Dream up, plan, and execute coordinated marketing campaigns across social,
, paid ads, influencers, and landing pages. We want your ideas — fall foliage, winter, and Black Friday are obvious starts, but think bigger.



6. Influencer Management: Find creators whose followers match our guests (fit matters more than follower count). Set up free stays in exchange for content — handle outreach, expectations, deadlines, and scheduling. Time their posts to land during active campaigns.



7. OTA Optimization: Monitor performance across Airbnb, VRBO, 
, Google, and Expedia. Keep photos, descriptions, and amenities current and consistent across channels.



8. AI Agent Supervision: Review AI-written guest responses each week to make sure they sound like us. Send emotional, safety, or money issues to the founder right away. Save common guest questions so we can train the AI better over time.



REQUIRED (2+ years experience)

Meta Ads Manager, social media management (IG + FB),
 platforms (Mailchimp/ConvertKit), copywriting, WordPress or similar CMS, Ai tools like ChatGPT/Claude.



NICE TO HAVE

Google Ads, hospitality experience, Canva/CapCut, Make/Zapier.



WHO YOU ARE

- A creative thinker who comes up with ideas, not just follows them

- Proactive — you spot opportunities and act before being asked

- You own the outcome, not just the task. You fix the system, not just the symptom.

- Coachable — you take feedback quickly and adjust based on results

- A warm communicator who writes like a person, not a brand

- Patient and steady — you stick with campaigns long enough to see results

- You want room to run, not a manager checking your work constantly

- Comfortable building the playbook, not just following one



SCHEDULE & PAY

- 40 hours/week, Mon–Fri, mostly flexible (2–3 hours per day must overlap with US Eastern Time)

- $5/hour USD, negotiable based on experience

- Performance bonuses for hitting goals on engagement, bookings, and ad results (we'll set specific targets in your first 30 days)

- 13th month pay (paid in December, prorated by start date), paid time off after 6 months, annual raises

- Tools: Microsoft 365, TimeProof



GROWTH

As we grow this property into a full year-round resort, your role, hours, and pay grow with it



HOW TO APPLY

2. Links to 2–3 social accounts you manage (Instagram preferred).

3. One Meta Ads screenshot from a campaign you ran (if you have one).

4. One creative campaign idea you'd pitch us.

title: Real Estate Closing Coordinator (U.S. Residential)
description:
About AIK Property Group



AIK Property Group is a residential real estate development company based in New York. We acquire, renovate, and sell homes while working closely with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, nonprofit organizations, and housing grant agencies.



We're looking for an experienced Real Estate Closing Coordinator who can take ownership of the transaction process and ensure every deal moves efficiently from contract execution to a successful closing.



This is not an entry-level position. We're seeking someone who already understands U.S. residential real estate transactions and can demonstrate that experience.



---



Your Mission



Your job is simple:



Keep every transaction moving toward closing.



You'll be responsible for coordinating multiple active transactions, anticipating issues before they become delays, following up relentlessly, and ensuring every party involved remains accountable.



You should always know:



* Which transactions are on track.

* Which transactions are at risk.

* What documents or approvals are outstanding.

* Who is responsible for the next action.

* What needs to happen today to move every file forward.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership—not someone who waits for instructions.



---



Key Responsibilities



* Coordinate residential real estate transactions from executed contract through closing.

* Manage multiple active transactions while maintaining accuracy and organization.

* Maintain transaction timelines and monitor all critical deadlines.

* Coordinate with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, contractors, grant administrators, and internal team members.

* Collect, organize, review, and track all required transaction documentation.

* Proactively identify and resolve issues that could delay closing.

* Maintain complete and organized transaction records.

* Provide accurate and timely updates on every active transaction.

* Ensure every transaction continues progressing until funding and closing are complete.



---



# What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of:



* U.S. residential real estate transactions

* Contract-to-close coordination

* Title and attorney coordination

* Lender communication and requirements

* Closing timelines and deadlines

* Document collection and compliance

* Managing multiple transactions simultaneously



You should also be comfortable learning and working within AIK Property Group's systems, including the **Greater Capital Association of REALTORS® (GCAR)** platform and other transaction management tools used by our team.



---



# Minimum Qualifications



* Minimum **3 years of experience** coordinating U.S. residential real estate transactions.

* Proven ability to successfully manage multiple active transactions simultaneously.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving abilities.

* Highly dependable, responsive, and detail-oriented.

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision.



---



# Application Requirements



We value demonstrated experience over résumé claims.



To be considered, your application must include all of the following:



* Updated résumé.

* Brief cover letter summarizing your real estate closing experience.

* Supporting evidence that demonstrates your transaction coordination experience.



Examples of acceptable supporting evidence include:



* Redacted closing checklists you managed.

* Sample transaction timelines.

* Screenshots of transaction pipelines or dashboards (with confidential information removed).

* Process documentation you created or maintained.

* Other work samples that clearly demonstrate your role in coordinating residential real estate closings.



Please remove or redact all confidential client information before submitting any documentation.



Applications submitted without supporting evidence will not be reviewed.



---



# Interview Process



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in a Transaction Case Review



During this session, you will be asked to share your screen and walk us through a completed transaction that you coordinated (using a redacted file or recreated workflow if necessary).



You should be prepared to explain:



* How the transaction progressed from contract to closing.

* The major milestones and deadlines.

* Challenges encountered during the process.

* How those challenges were resolved.

* How you kept all parties accountable.

* How you organize and prioritize multiple active transactions.



This is not intended to test memorization. We want to understand how you think, communicate, solve problems, and manage real-world transactions.



---



# What Success Looks Like



A successful Closing Coordinator:



* Keeps transactions moving without constant supervision.

* Anticipates issues before they become closing delays.

* Maintains proactive communication with every stakeholder.

* Keeps organized and accurate transaction files.

* Meets deadlines consistently.

* Takes ownership of every transaction from contract to closing.



When someone asks about the status of a file, you already know the answer.



---



# Who Will Thrive in This Role



You'll be a great fit if you are:



* Proactive.

* Organized.

* Reliable.

* Detail-oriented.

* Accountable.

* Calm under pressure.

* Comfortable making decisions and taking ownership.

* Committed to delivering successful closings—not simply completing assigned tasks.



---



# How to Apply



Please
 your application to:







**Required
 Subject Format**



**Closing Coordinator – F. LAST NAME**



**Example:** `Closing Coordinator – J. DELA CRUZ`



Applications that do not follow the required subject format or do not include the requested supporting documentation may not be considered.



---



Our Hiring Philosophy



At AIK Property Group, we hire based on capability, ownership, reliability, and demonstrated experience—not résumé claims alone.



If you're someone who takes pride in keeping transactions organized, solving problems before they become obstacles, and ensuring every closing reaches the finish line, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video editor
description:
Social Media Video Editor + Content Strategist — Personal Brand



I’m looking for a high-level video editor with a strong understanding of social media to help take my personal brand to the next level.



I don’t just need someone who knows how to use editing software. I need someone who understands attention, hooks, storytelling, pacing, retention, and what makes people stop scrolling.



You should have a great eye for style, a fast turnaround time, and be comfortable producing multiple pieces of content per day.



What you'll be doing



You'll be working with a library of raw footage and turning it into polished, engaging social content, including:



* Instagram Reels / short-form videos

* Talking-head content

* B-roll with text overlays

* Carousels and static posts

* Educational content

* Story-driven videos

* Clips pulled from longer-form footage



Some projects will be straightforward. For example, I may give you several teleprompter takes and need you to comb through the footage, identify the strongest takes, remove mistakes, and turn them into a polished video.



Other projects will require much more creativity. I may give you raw footage with no exact script, and I need you to be able to watch it, identify the interesting story or idea, develop the hook, and turn it into something people actually want to watch.



I'm looking for someone who understands CONTENT — not just editing.



You should understand:



* How important the first 1–3 seconds are

* Hooks and curiosity

* Storytelling and pacing

* Retention and watch time

* Text placement and on-screen captions

* B-roll and pattern interrupts

* When an edit should be fast and punchy vs. simple and clean

* How to repurpose one piece of footage into multiple pieces of content

* Current short-form content styles and trends

* How to make content feel native to Instagram/TikTok rather than overly produced



Most importantly, I want someone who is willing to pay attention to the numbers. If something gets 2,000 views and something else gets 50,000, I want you asking: Why? What was different about the hook? The topic? The edit? The pacing? The format? I want someone who learns from what performs, recognizes what flops, and continuously helps us make better content.



The goal



Ultimately, your job is to help me turn:



Raw footage ? great content ? consistent posting ? more views ? a stronger personal brand.



I want to be able to send you footage and trust that you're going to find the gold in it.



To apply



Please send me:



1. 3–5 examples of short-form content you've personally edited.

2. Links to any social media accounts you've helped grow or regularly created content for.

3. A short video introducing yourself and telling me about your experience.

4. Tell me about one Reel/TikTok you've edited that performed extremely well and WHY you think it worked.

5. Tell me what you would do if we posted 10 videos and 8 of them underperformed.



I'm looking for someone who is creative, fast, reliable, accountable, and obsessed with making better content.



If you're simply looking for someone to hand you exact timestamps and editing instructions for every video, this probably isn't the right position.



If you love taking a pile of raw footage and figuring out how to turn it into content people actually want to consume, I want to hear from you.

title: Short-form Script Writer
description:
# Short-form Script Writer



**One opening | Remote — Philippines | Full-time contractor**



**Salary:** PHP 30,000–40,000 per month



**Payment:** Monthly



**Availability:** Across most of the UK workday, including a daily team stand-up call





## About the Role



We’re looking for someone who is chronically online—in the best possible way.



You probably spend too much time on TikTok, immediately understand why an influencer is trending and regularly find yourself explaining the latest celebrity feud, creator controversy or piece of internet drama to everyone else.



Then please apply for this role!



You’ll research and write **five scripts per working day** for 3–5-minute Snapchat videos. Scripts will typically be approximately **450–750 words each**, depending on the story and voiceover pace.



Each script needs a powerful hook, enough context for anyone to understand the story, constant forward momentum and a payoff that makes the audience glad they stayed.



You’ll also learn the specialist niches covered by our editors—including celebrities, influencers, sports, hip-hop and crime—and develop a strong understanding of the topics, personalities and angles that perform within each one.





## What You’ll Be Doing



- **Find stories worth covering**

    - Stay immersed in U.S. culture, TikTok, influencers, celebrities, music, sports and internet drama.

    - Identify timely topics that fit the specialist niches covered by our editors.

    - Find the most interesting angle rather than simply repeating what has already been reported.



- **Research and write five scripts per day**

    - Produce five engaging **3–5-minute scripts each working day**.

    - Write approximately **450–750 words per script**, depending on pacing.

    - Structure each story around a strong hook, essential context, escalating developments and a clear payoff.

    - Verify important facts, quotes, timelines and sources before including them.



- **Build niche expertise**

    - Learn the key personalities, communities and recurring stories within each editor’s niche.

    - Understand which topics and angles are most likely to perform.

    - Work with the editors and Managing Director to identify future stories.



- **Collaborate and improve**

    - Attend the daily team stand-up call.

    - Remain available and responsive across most of the UK workday.

    - Revise scripts quickly in response to feedback.

    - Use AI tools to support research and ideation while taking responsibility for the final script.





## What We’re Looking For



- A genuine obsession with **U.S. culture, TikTok influencers and the latest internet drama**.

- Someone who naturally follows stories as they develop rather than discovering them several days later.

- Strong examples of relevant scripts, articles, stories or other narrative work.

- Excellent written English and a natural understanding of spoken storytelling.

- Strong instincts for hooks, curiosity, tension, pacing and narrative payoff.

- The ability to research quickly without sacrificing accuracy.

- The ability to learn unfamiliar niches and become genuinely knowledgeable about them.

- Reliability, curiosity and clear communication within a fast-moving remote team.





## What Matters to Us



We don’t care where you went to school, how many years of experience appear on your CV or what you look like.



We care about:



- Whether you can find the real story inside a topic.

- How deeply you understand internet culture.

- How quickly you can research and learn.

- Whether you can write something people want to keep watching.

- What unique knowledge, voice and perspective you bring to the team.





## How to Apply



 
 with the subject:



**Scriptwriter Application — [Your Name]**



Include only these four things:

1. Your CV.

2. Links or files containing your most relevant stories.

3. A short explanation of why you are the right fit.

4. Your earliest possible start date.



We review and respond to applications daily. Keep an eye on your inbox and spam folder to find out whether you have been selected for the next stage. We will let you know either way.





## Hiring Process



1. Application and writing review.

2. A **$20 paid 500-word test story** for selected candidates.

3. Interview.

4. Final job offer.



For the paid task, you’ll receive a shared topic and relevant source material. You’ll be asked to write a **500-word test story** containing:



- A strong hook that creates curiosity without immediately revealing the entire story.

- An introduction containing the background needed to understand the topic.

- A concise body that breaks down the key developments.

- Clear progression, with every line adding new information or value.



Only candidates specifically invited to the paid-task stage should complete the task.





## **About Us**



Don’t Buy Media is a Gen Z media start-up. We build Gen Z community by Gen Z across Gen Z’s platforms for brands and ourselves.
